text: 28 August 2026
translated: 28 August 2026

text: The Simplicity example in Options no longer shows a line the game does not print.
translated: The Simplicity example in 选项 no longer shows a line the game does not print.

text: The beast's plate no longer shoves the panel beside it as fights start and end.
translated: The 野兽's plate no longer shoves the panel beside it as fights start and end.

text: The “turn sound on” prompt no longer returns for every adventurer. It asks once, after your first boss.
translated: The “turn sound on” prompt no longer returns for every adventurer. It asks once, after your first 首领.

text: “Send for this one now” now works with a full party. The yard asks which hand steps down, and that hand keeps its study.
translated: “Send for this one now” now works with a full party. The yard asks which hand steps down, and that hand keeps its study.

text: The off-hand feat is now read by every fitting, so Auto-equip no longer strips your second weapon for a shield.
translated: The off-hand feat is now read by every fitting, so Auto-equip no longer strips your second weapon for a 盾牌.

text: The Armoury now hands over the second weapon, and toggling the off-hand feat re-fits your kit on the spot
translated: 军械库 now hands over the second weapon, and toggling the off-hand feat re-fits your kit on the spot

text: The Red Hour wrote to the log many times a second. It writes once now.
translated: The Red Hour wrote to the log many times a second. It writes once now.

text: With Simple wording on, the school tooltip promised spell names and never showed them.
translated: With Simple wording on, the school tooltip promised 法术 names and never showed them.

text: The ability row slid under the header when you scrolled the list. It stays in place now.
translated: The 能力 row slid under the header when you scrolled the list. It stays in place now.

text: When two spells were tied, the wrong one sat on top. The firing one sits on top now.
translated: When two spells were tied, the wrong one sat on top. The firing one sits on top now.

text: Clearing the wall before v1.6.2 never gave “The Hand That Walked Out”. It does now.
translated: Clearing the wall before v1.6.2 never gave “The Hand That Walked Out”. It does now.

text: Four set accessories had no description in the armoury book. They show their bonus now.
translated: Four set accessories had no description in the armoury book. They show their bonus now.

text: Single-source items now say “and no other way” instead of “and off no other door”.
translated: Single-source items now say “and no other way” instead of “and off no other door”.

text: 25 August 2026
translated: 25 August 2026

text: The four new pets could not eat. Now they eat.
translated: The four new pets could not eat. Now they eat.

text: Vane still doubles the chance.
translated: 维恩 still doubles the chance.

text: The cave-shrike, road-mole, magpie and mist-hare ate nothing and never grew.
translated: The 洞穴尖啸鸟, 道路鼹鼠, magpie and 雾兔 ate nothing and never grew.

text: Pets already on your Roll start growing from the next stroke, leg or chest.
translated: 宠物 already on your Roll start growing from the next stroke, leg or chest.

text: A pet's door now opens the moment it is earned, instead of at the next kill.
translated: A pet's door now opens the moment it is earned, instead of at the next kill.

text: A fully grown mist-hare shows a full bar at its tenth growth, which is its cap.
translated: A fully grown 雾兔 shows a full bar at its tenth growth, which is its cap.

text: A fast chronicle spent seconds on road legs and earned almost no descent for them.
translated: A fast chronicle spent seconds on 道路路段 and earned almost no descent for them.

text: 24 August 2026
translated: 24 August 2026

text: New items, pets, a hireling, and a folk and an origin to unlock. Details on Steam.
translated: 新增物品、宠物、雇员、种族和出身等待解锁。详情请见 Steam。

text: Every folk, trade and origin gift is lifted. Details on Steam.
translated: Every 种族, 职业 and 出身 gift is lifted. Details on Steam.

text: 22 August 2026
translated: 22 August 2026

text: A kinder Infirmary, earlier camps, and a tidier Options.
translated: A kinder Infirmary, earlier camps, and a tidier 选项.

text: The Infirmary's stay is capped at two and a half minutes, was ten, and a camp is made below half your hit points, was a quarter.
translated: The Infirmary's stay is capped at two and a half minutes, was ten, and a camp is made below half your 生命值, was a quarter.

text: The Armoury can show only the kit you are wearing, and can find a pattern by name.
translated: 军械库 can show only the kit you are wearing, and can find a pattern by name.

text: Works endowed in full stand below the works still asking, at the Guildhouse.
translated: Works endowed in full stand below the works still asking, at the 行会大厅.

text: Options groups fold away on a click of the group's name, and the sheet of first answers is named the Experience wizard there. It is asked once of every ledger that never answered it.
translated: 选项 groups fold away on a click of the group's name, and the sheet of first answers is named the 经验 wizard there. It is asked once of every ledger that never answered it.

text: Playing by hand, a drop that betters your kit says so in the log, and the Armoury button counts the register pieces that wait.
translated: Playing by hand, a drop that betters your kit says so in the log, and the 军械库 button counts the register pieces that wait.

text: The Roll of Honour takes a reset: every upgrade unbought and every point returned, to be spent afresh.
translated: The Roll of Honour takes a reset: every upgrade unbought and every point returned, to be spent afresh.

text: The bone-dog pays +2 max HP a growth, was +1.
translated: The 骨犬 pays +2 max 生命值 a growth, was +1.

text: The physician's leech pays +2 max MP a growth, was +1.
translated: The 医师水蛭 pays +2 max 法力值 a growth, was +1.

text: Damage figures in the fight log no longer print a tail of decimals.
translated: 伤害 figures in the fight log no longer print a tail of decimals.

text: The armoury wall names its pieces as the sheet does, not by their catalog marks.
translated: The armoury wall names its pieces as the sheet does, not by their catalog marks.

text: No more double articles at the wall: taken off the Maw-boar, not off a the Maw-boar.
translated: No more double articles at the wall: taken off the Maw-boar, not off a the Maw-boar.

text: Mastered counts only beasts the bestiary lists, so the figure cannot stand above the book.
translated: Mastered counts only beasts the bestiary lists, so the figure cannot stand above the book.

text: A worn piece wears its catalog rarity's colour: the kit and the armoury book no longer disagree.
translated: A worn piece wears its catalog rarity's colour: the kit and the armoury book no longer disagree.

text: The Armoury's Equip button stands down while the very version it would fit is worn.
translated: 军械库's Equip button stands down while the very version it would fit is worn.

text: The Roll of Pets counts along while it stands open, rather than at the opening alone.
translated: 宠物名册 counts along while it stands open, rather than at the opening alone.

text: 21 August 2026
translated: 21 August 2026

text: The Steam bundle: the fight on the die, a signature move for every trade, pets, feats and desks.
translated: The Steam bundle: the fight on the die, a signature move for every 职业, pets, feats and desks.

text: Fights are on the die: attack rolls, damage dice, statblocked beasts that leave a mark. Kit is four named slots.
translated: Fights are on the die: attack rolls, damage dice, statblocked beasts that leave a mark. Kit is four named slots.

text: Casters fight from INT, WIS or CHA. Every trade has one signature move, and a plus beside it opens its upgrades.
translated: Casters fight from INT, WIS or CHA. Every 职业 has one signature move, and a plus beside it opens its upgrades.

text: Three pets now: the chest, the bone-dog and the leech. One walks at your heel, and only that one pays.
translated: Three pets now: the chest, the 骨犬 and the leech. One walks at your heel, and only that one pays.

text: Feats are earned by a deed and bought with prestige: 13 on the board, and your papers hold 3.
translated: 专长 are earned by a deed and bought with prestige: 13 on the board, and your papers hold 3.

text: The folk and trade gifts are recut; Shop, Prestige and Guildhouse all grew; Options adds a play style switch and three desks.
translated: The 种族 and 职业 gifts are recut; Shop, 声望 and 行会大厅 all grew; 选项 adds a play style switch and three desks.

text: An update too large for this window: the full patch notes are the v1.6.0 post on Steam.
translated: An update too large for this window: the full patch notes are the v1.6.0 post on Steam.

text: 16 August 2026
translated: 16 August 2026

text: Prestige pays for depth now, in both modules.
translated: 声望 pays for depth now, in both modules.

text: Retiring pays for how deep you got. Rank, bosses and gold scale with depth.
translated: Retiring pays for how deep you got. 阶位, bosses and 金币 scale with depth.

text: Retiring on Arc I pays 2 prestige, was 25. A full Maw run still pays 406.
translated: Retiring on Arc I pays 2 prestige, was 25. A full Maw run still pays 406.

text: Module II changed the same way: a full Vale run is 1,852 prestige, was 85.
translated: Module II changed the same way: a full Vale run is 1,852 prestige, was 85.

text: Beating the Count pays 700 prestige. Module II's last chapter paid 2 before.
translated: Beating the Count pays 700 prestige. Module II's last 章节 paid 2 before.

text: An oath opens once one of its two rings is closed, which is all eight skills.
translated: An oath opens once one of its two rings is closed, which is all eight skills.

text: That puts it at the 221st skill of a run, where it stood at the 214th.
translated: That puts it at the 221st skill of a run, where it stood at the 214th.

text: Retire says why a shallow run pays nothing, instead of an empty list.
translated: 退休 says why a shallow run pays nothing, instead of an empty list.

text: A choice answered during a market trip has its trophy sold with the rest.
translated: A choice answered during a market trip has its 战利品 sold with the rest.

text: The sheet's list headers stay in front of the rows scrolling under them.
translated: The sheet's list headers stay in front of the rows scrolling under them.

text: A beast mastered in an earlier chronicle says so, instead of reading mastered at ×0.
translated: A 野兽 mastered in an earlier chronicle says so, instead of reading mastered at ×0.

text: Every window says the same kills to a mastery: 10, or 5 with the Annotated Bestiary.
translated: Every window says the same kills to a mastery: 10, or 5 with the Annotated 怪物图鉴.

text: The New gear button's tooltip changes with the order on every click.
translated: The New gear button's tooltip changes with the order on every click.

text: A tooltip held over an item stays up when the list repaints under it.
translated: A tooltip 持有 over an item stays up when the list repaints under it.

text: Profile counts a stage of an event in its own unit: goblins, or damage at a boss.
translated: Profile counts a stage of an event in its own unit: goblins, or damage at a 首领.

text: An event badge is named for what you did, so it reads the same at every stage.
translated: An event badge is named for what you did, so it reads the same at every stage.

translated: 12 August 2026

text: Events open, and the Guild calls its first muster.
translated: Events open, and the 行会 calls its first muster.

text: Events (menu): live events, the whole membership standing at one board.
translated: Events (menu): live events, the whole membership standing at one board.

text: The first opens 13 August, 12:00 CEST: three stages, 24 hours each.
translated: The first opens 13 August, 12:00 CEST: three stages, 24 hours each.

text: Stand hours at it while you play. An hour counts the same at every rank.
translated: Stand hours at it while you play. An hour counts the same at every rank.

text: Carry all three stages and the ending goes to a vote of the members.
translated: Carry all three stages and the ending goes to a vote of the members.

text: Every badge you take at a muster is a point of voice in its vote.
translated: Every badge you take at a muster is a point of voice in its vote.

text: Profile keeps your hours and badges; History keeps what the Guild chose.
translated: Profile keeps your hours and badges; History keeps what the 行会 chose.

text: Retire opens at every rank. The pension it pays still opens at the 5th.
translated: 退休 opens at every rank. The pension it pays still opens at the 5th.

text: A concluded season says +1 prestige point only when it pays one.
translated: A concluded season says +1 prestige point only when it pays one.

text: A skipped season says so, and gives the rate the taper has thinned to.
translated: A skipped season says so, and gives the rate the taper has thinned to.

text: Retire says how many points your court seasons actually paid.
translated: 退休 says how many points your court seasons actually paid.

text: Prestige and the victory screens say the rate halves every 12 seasons.
translated: 声望 and the victory screens say the rate halves every 12 seasons.

text: Endow a recovery party says its point is paid in full every time.
translated: Endow a recovery party says its point is paid in full every time.

text: Guildhouse, Shop, Feats and Skill Tree show your gold as it changes.
translated: 行会大厅, Shop, 专长 and Skill Tree show your 金币 as it changes.

text: A buy the purse has fallen short of says what it asks and what you hold.
translated: A buy the purse has fallen short of says what it asks and what you hold.

text: Two hirelings take a line each, and their trades read out in full.
translated: Two hirelings take a line each, and their trades read out in full.

text: The sheet keeps its three even columns whatever a panel has to say.
translated: The sheet keeps its three even columns whatever a panel has to say.

text: A beast's health bar empties all the way to zero at speed, as its number did.
translated: A 野兽's health bar empties all the way to zero at 速度, as its number did.

text: Master Wickett dries and weighs the fen goods, pays over the odds for the linen, and rules the line beneath without meeting your eye.

text: The curtain wall of Corvane rings the crag entire, and the breach in it was made from the inside, and the stone lies outward down the slope.
translated: The curtain wall of Corvane rings the crag entire, and the breach in it was made from the inside, and the 石 lies outward down the slope.

text: The kennels stand against the wall in a long row of forty runs, and the runs are swept, and the straw is fresh, and thirty-nine of the gates stand open.
translated: The kennels stand against the wall in a long row of forty runs, and the runs are swept, and the straw is fresh, and thirty-nine of the gates stand open.

text: The feeding-trough of the kennels is filled to the hour by a hand that keeps the hour, and the meat in it is fresh, and there is no butcher in the Vale.
translated: The feeding-trough of the kennels is filled to the hour by a hand that keeps the hour, and the meat in it is fresh, and there is no butcher in the Vale.

text: A hunting-board is nailed inside the gate with the season's meets written up in a fair hand, and the last entry upon it is dated for tomorrow.
translated: A hunting-board is nailed inside the gate with the season's meets written up in a fair hand, and the last entry upon it is dated for tomorrow.

text: The gatehouse portcullis is up and pinned, and the pins are greased, and the winding-gear turns under one hand as smoothly as a well-kept lock.
translated: The gatehouse portcullis is up and pinned, and the pins are greased, and the winding-gear turns under one hand as smoothly as a well-kept lock.

text: Kennel-hounds bay from somewhere below the wall in a body, all at once and then all silent, the way a pack answers a horn it has been taught.
translated: Kennel-hounds bay from somewhere below the wall in a body, all at once and then all silent, the way a pack answers a horn it has been taught.

text: The stable-yard holds one coach with its lamps trimmed and its harness laid out ready, and the coach has neither horses in it nor dust upon it.
translated: The stable-yard holds one coach with its lamps trimmed and its harness laid out ready, and the coach has neither horses in it nor dust upon it.

text: From the wall-walk the whole Vale lies below you under its mist, village and wood and orchard and fen, and every road in it runs to the crag you stand on.
translated: From the wall-walk the whole Vale lies below you under its mist, village and wood and orchard and fen, and every road in it runs to the crag you stand on.

text: The armoury within the gatehouse is racked and oiled and complete, and every weapon in it is set with its edge toward the door.
translated: The armoury within the gatehouse is racked and oiled and complete, and every weapon in it is set with its edge toward the door.

text: A tally of the pack is chalked upon the kennel wall in a fair hand and corrected daily, and today's figure is thirty-nine, and there are forty runs.
translated: A tally of the pack is chalked upon the kennel wall in a fair hand and corrected daily, and today's figure is thirty-nine, and there are forty runs.

text: The wall-walk is swept from end to end, and the sweepings are heaped tidily at the stair-head where somebody means to come back for them.
translated: The wall-walk is swept from end to end, and the sweepings are heaped tidily at the stair-head where somebody means to come back for them.

text: Bells are hung along the inside of the curtain at intervals, on wires that run inward to the house, and every one of them is a bell for going out rather than for coming in.
translated: Bells are hung along the inside of the curtain at intervals, on wires that run inward to the house, and every one of them is a bell for going out rather than for coming in.

text: A brazier at the wall-head holds a fire banked and living, and there is a stack of split wood beside it cut to the length of the brazier, seasoned two years.
translated: A brazier at the wall-head holds a fire banked and living, and there is a stack of split wood beside it cut to the length of the brazier, seasoned two years.

text: The mist stands level with the wall-walk and goes no higher, so that the crag is an island and the whole of the Vale beneath it is under water that is not water.
translated: The mist stands level with the wall-walk and goes no higher, so that the crag is an island and the whole of the Vale beneath it is under water that is not water.

text: Master Wickett will not come up the crag, and so the counter comes to you: a strongbox left at the breach, and the price chalked upon the lid in his hand.
translated: Master Wickett will not come up the crag, and so the 商店 comes to you: a strongbox left at the breach, and the price chalked upon the lid in his hand.

text: "Off the wall itself," says the chalk upon the strongbox lid, and the sum beside it is generous, and the box is emptied and refilled by the time you pass again.
translated: "Off the wall itself," says the chalk upon the strongbox lid, and the sum beside it is generous, and the box is emptied and refilled by the time you pass again.

text: The chandler's boy leaves the strongbox at the breach at first light, takes what you have left in it, and never once looks up at the castle.
translated: The chandler's boy leaves the strongbox at the breach at first light, takes what you have left in it, and never once looks up at the castle.

text: Castle Corvane is kept: the floors are swept, the glass is clean, the fires are laid, and the house has had no servants for three hundred years.
translated: Castle Corvane is kept: the floors are swept, the glass is clean, the fires are laid, and the house has had no servants for three hundred years.

text: Covers are off the furniture in every room of the state floor, and the covers are folded and stacked, and the folding is recent and done to a housekeeper's standard.
translated: Covers are off the furniture in every room of the state 楼层, and the covers are folded and stacked, and the folding is recent and 完成 to a housekeeper's standard.

text: The long gallery hangs with portraits of one family in its generations, and the same man stands in the corner of every canvas, and he does not age between them.
translated: The long gallery hangs with portraits of one family in its generations, and the same man stands in the corner of every canvas, and he does not age between them.

text: A place is laid at the head of the great table for one, with the plate turned down and the glass turned up, and it has been laid this way since the burial.
translated: A place is laid at the head of the great table for one, with the plate turned down and the glass turned up, and it has been laid this way since the burial.

text: The chapel of the castle is shuttered from within and its door wedged with a beam, and the wedge was set by someone standing on the inside.
translated: The chapel of the castle is shuttered from within and its door wedged with a beam, and the wedge was set by someone standing on the inside.

text: Music is played in the music-room at the same hour every evening, one instrument and one air, and the air is a wedding air played at half the pace it was written for.
translated: Music is played in the music-room at the same hour every evening, one instrument and one air, and the air is a wedding air played at half the pace it was written for.

text: The great stair is carpeted and the carpet is worn in one track only, up the middle, by three hundred years of one man's feet going up and coming down.
translated: The great stair is carpeted and the carpet is worn in one track only, up the middle, by three hundred years of one man's feet going up and coming down.

text: The Count's own chamber stands open at the head of the stair, and the bed in it is made, and it has never once been slept in.
translated: The Count's own chamber stands open at the head of the stair, and the bed in it is made, and it has never once been slept in.

text: The kitchens are laid out for a household of forty: coppers scoured, spits greased, the great table floured for pastry that nobody has come down to make.
translated: The kitchens are laid out for a household of forty: coppers scoured, spits greased, the great table floured for pastry that nobody has come down to make.

text: A clock upon the landing keeps the right hour and is wound every eight days by a hand you never meet, and its case has been opened so often the varnish is worn about the key-hole.
translated: A clock upon the landing keeps the right hour and is wound every eight days by a hand you never meet, and its case has been opened so often the varnish is worn about the key-hole.

text: The library is catalogued and shelved and the ladders are set where a reader left them, and the book upon the reading-desk is open at a page about the keeping of hounds.
translated: The library is catalogued and shelved and the ladders are set where a reader left them, and the book upon the reading-desk is open at a page about the keeping of hounds.

text: Linen is aired upon a horse before the fire in a room with no bed in it, and it is aired again the next day, and the day after that.
translated: Linen is aired upon a horse before the fire in a room with no bed in it, and it is aired again the next day, and the day after that.

text: The great hall's fires are laid but never lit, kindling under split logs under a taper, in every one of the six hearths, and the tapers are new.
translated: The great hall's fires are laid but never lit, kindling under split logs under a taper, in every one of the six hearths, and the tapers are new.

text: Water stands ready in the ewers of every guest chamber on the state floor, fresh drawn, and there has not been a guest in this house since the burial.
translated: Water stands ready in the ewers of every guest chamber on the state 楼层, fresh drawn, and there has not been a guest in this house since the burial.

text: Somewhere below the state floor a door closes, without hurry and without violence, the way a door closes behind somebody who lives there.
translated: Somewhere below the state 楼层 a door closes, without hurry and without violence, the way a door closes behind somebody who lives there.

text: The strongbox at the breach takes what comes out of the castle too, and Master Wickett's chalk upon the lid is a shade less steady for it.
translated: The strongbox at the breach takes what comes out of the castle too, and Master Wickett's chalk upon the lid is a shade less steady for it.

text: "House goods," says the chalk, and the sum beside it is the best price the Vale has ever paid, and the box stands waiting each time you come down.
translated: "House goods," says the chalk, and the sum beside it is the best price the Vale has ever paid, and the box stands waiting each time you come down.

text: The chandler's boy leaves the box, takes the castle's plate away wrapped in sacking, and runs the last of the crag road rather than walks it.
translated: The chandler's boy leaves the box, takes the castle's plate away wrapped in sacking, and runs the last of the crag road rather than walks it.

text: A predator of living stone, patient as the rock it mimics. It may perch motionless for years awaiting prey.

text: A malevolent light that haunts the drowned places, luring travellers from the safe path into deep water.
translated: A malevolent light that haunts the drowned places, luring travellers from the safe path into deep water.

text: A horror with the body of a great bear and the visage of an owl, infamous for its ferocity. It attacks on sight and fights to the death.

text: A hulking giant-kin of dim wit and prodigious strength, with a taste for man-flesh. A single blow of its club can fell an armoured warrior.

text: A spirit of hatred given form in shadow. Weapons of common steel pass through it as through smoke.
