text: A monster with the body of a lion, the face of a man, and a tail of iron spikes, which it hurls with deadly accuracy.
translated: A monster with the body of a lion, the face of a man, and a tail of iron spikes, which it hurls with deadly accuracy.

text: A two-headed giant, filthy and quarrelsome. Its heads argue without cease, but upon the matter of intruders they are of one mind.
translated: A two-headed giant, filthy and quarrelsome. Its heads argue without cease, but upon the matter of intruders they are of one mind.

text: A brutish giant twice the height of a man, come down into the deep in search of plunder and meat.
translated: A brutish giant twice the height of a man, come down into the deep in search of plunder and meat.

text: The least of the true dragons, yet a dragon nonetheless. Its breath is a killing frost, and the cold of it precedes it down the halls.
translated: The least of the true dragons, yet a dragon nonetheless. Its breath is a killing frost, and the cold of it precedes it down the halls.

text: A cruel and cunning wyrm whose breath is a cloud of poison. It parleys only to gain advantage, and honours no parley.
translated: A cruel and cunning wyrm whose breath is a cloud of poison. It parleys only to gain advantage, and honours no parley.

text: A three-headed abomination: lion, goat, and dragon upon one body, each head as murderous as the last.
translated: A three-headed abomination: lion, goat, and dragon upon one body, each head as murderous as the last.

text: A lesser cousin of the dragonkind, all wings and fangs, with a sting heavy with venom. It hunts the deep shafts on silent wings.
translated: A lesser cousin of the dragonkind, all wings and fangs, with a sting heavy with venom. It hunts the deep shafts on silent wings.

text: A corpse returned from death to pursue a debt of vengeance. Neither steel nor stone nor prayer will stay it from its quarry.
translated: A corpse returned from death to pursue a debt of vengeance. Neither steel nor 石 nor prayer will stay it from its quarry.

text: The thrall of some deeper power, pale and swift and terribly strong. It fears the sun it will never again see.
translated: The thrall of some deeper power, pale and swift and terribly strong. It fears the sun it will never again see.

text: A swamp-dwelling wyrm of vile temper whose breath is a stream of scalding acid. It is the master of the drowned dark.
translated: A swamp-dwelling wyrm of vile temper whose breath is a stream of scalding acid. It is the master of the drowned dark.

text: A cave-dweller that hangs among the stalactites, indistinguishable from the stone, until it drops upon its prey and smothers the light and the breath together.
translated: A cave-dweller that hangs among the stalactites, indistinguishable from the 石, until it drops upon its prey and smothers the light and the breath together.

text: A goblin of the emptied warren, gone below and changed by its cargo. It carries a sliver of the black stone strapped to its back with rope and reverence, and it defends the burden before its own life.
translated: A goblin of the emptied warren, gone below and changed by its cargo. It carries a sliver of the black 石 strapped to its back with rope and reverence, and it defends the burden before its own life.

text: A great block of living jelly, fitted to the corridors it sweeps. It is all but invisible when still, and the undissolved oddments hanging within it are the only warning given.
translated: A great block of living jelly, fitted to the corridors it sweeps. It is all but invisible when still, and the undissolved oddments hanging within it are the only warning given.

text: An eyeless once-man of the deep places, hunting by ear and by nose with terrible accuracy. Its people traded their eyes to the dark long ago, and hold the bargain a fair one.
translated: An eyeless once-man of the deep places, hunting by ear and by nose with terrible accuracy. Its people traded their eyes to the dark long ago, and hold the bargain a fair one.

text: A great shaggy goblin-kin, silent as falling dust for all its bulk. It strikes from ambush with a reach that mocks the measure of its arms.
translated: A great shaggy goblin-kin, silent as falling dust for all its bulk. It strikes from ambush with a reach that mocks the measure of its arms.

text: A goblin marked by the stone below: grey-eyed, unhurried, and given to drawing what it dreams. The drawings are all of one subject, and the subject is a standing stone made whole.
translated: A goblin marked by the 石 below: grey-eyed, unhurried, and given to drawing what it dreams. The drawings are all of one subject, and the subject is a standing 石 made whole.

text: A grey, spider-tending horror of the webbed galleries. It herds its flock as a shepherd does, and strings its snares with a craftsman's pride.
translated: A grey, spider-tending horror of the webbed galleries. It herds its flock as a shepherd does, and strings its snares with a craftsman's pride.

text: A monstrous cousin of the merfolk, harpoon-armed and cruel, that hunts the sunless waters. It drags the hooked to the deep at leisure.
translated: A monstrous cousin of the merfolk, harpoon-armed and cruel, that hunts the sunless waters. It drags the hooked to the deep at leisure.

text: A coil of animate water, bound long ago to guard a basin or a road, and past caring which travellers its orders once excepted.
translated: A coil of animate water, bound long ago to guard a basin or a road, and past caring which travellers its orders once excepted.

text: A great armoured horror of the deep lakes, pincered and patient, that gathers the goods of the drowned beneath its shallows and suffers none to reclaim them.
translated: A great armoured horror of the deep lakes, pincered and patient, that gathers the goods of the drowned beneath its shallows and suffers none to reclaim them.

text: A man-high fungus that screams at light and movement. Its cry is the deep's own alarum, and everything hungry hears it.
translated: A man-high fungus that screams at light and movement. Its cry is the deep's own alarum, and everything hungry hears it.

text: A rooted horror whose touch rots living flesh upon the bone. It stands among the harmless kinds, and the unwary reach past it to their cost.
translated: A rooted horror whose touch rots living flesh upon the bone. It stands among the harmless kinds, and the unwary reach past it to their cost.

text: A creeping slime that passes for wet stone and eats through steel at its leisure. The pitted floors of the vaults are its ledger.
translated: A creeping slime that passes for wet 石 and eats through steel at its leisure. The pitted floors of the vaults are its ledger.

text: A three-legged eater of refuse, vast of mouth and foul of temper, that squats beneath the middens of the deep and falls upon whatever disturbs its feeding.
translated: A three-legged eater of refuse, vast of mouth and foul of temper, that squats beneath the middens of the deep and falls upon whatever disturbs its feeding.

text: A grey dwarf of the deep roads, joyless and exact, that works gangs of the pressed and the purchased. It carries the pick as its badge of office, and its whistle orders the dark about it by rote.
translated: A grey dwarf of the deep roads, joyless and exact, that works gangs of the pressed and the purchased. It carries the pick as its badge of office, and its whistle orders the dark about it by rote.

text: A pillar of living stone with one yellow eye and a fistful of gripping strands, planted where the road narrows. Whole caravans have gone into that patience.
translated: A pillar of living 石 with one yellow eye and a fistful of gripping strands, planted where the road narrows. Whole caravans have gone into that patience.

text: A horror wearing a drow's shoulders upon a great spider's body, exiled below by its own kind. It weaves its grudges into the silk.
translated: A horror wearing a drow's shoulders upon a great spider's body, exiled below by its own kind. It weaves its grudges into the silk.

text: A tide of hungry black acid that pours itself down walls and through gratings, and eats what it engulfs, steel and bone alike.
translated: A tide of hungry black acid that pours itself down walls and through gratings, and eats what it engulfs, steel and bone alike.

text: A crawling ground of mouths and eyes that babbles in the voices of everything it has eaten. The babble unseats reason; the ground itself goes soft with its passing.
translated: A crawling ground of mouths and eyes that babbles in the voices of everything it has eaten. The babble unseats reason; the ground itself goes soft with its passing.

text: A body grown through with the black stone, walking upon the stone's business. What remains of the man or goblin within is carried along as a passenger.
translated: A body grown through with the black 石, walking upon the 石's business. What remains of the man or goblin within is carried along as a passenger.

text: A servant of bound air, sent upon an errand and tireless until the errand is done. It announces itself only by the dust it disturbs.
translated: A servant of bound air, sent upon an errand and tireless until the errand is 完成. It announces itself only by the dust it disturbs.

text: A great serpent crowned with a woman's face, wise in old sorceries and older grudges. Slain, it gathers itself anew within a handful of days, for its spirit holds the flesh cheap.
translated: A great serpent crowned with a woman's face, wise in old sorceries and older grudges. Slain, it gathers itself anew within a handful of days, for its spirit holds the flesh cheap.

text: A patient predator that takes the shape of a chest, a door, a barrel: whatever a tired traveller reaches for. The grip of its hide is the grip of hot pitch, and it eats what it holds.
translated: A patient predator that takes the shape of a chest, a door, a barrel: whatever a tired traveller reaches for. The grip of its hide is the grip of hot pitch, and it eats what it holds.

text: A grey, smooth-limbed thing that wears the faces of others as a trade. In the counterfeit town it keeps whole households, and it studies its callers before it greets them.
translated: A grey, smooth-limbed thing that wears the faces of others as a 职业. In the counterfeit town it keeps whole households, and it studies its callers before it greets them.

text: A citizen of the town below, jointed of wood and wax under good town clothes. It keeps its rounds, gives the hour in a fair voice, and strikes when the street is empty.
translated: A citizen of the town below, jointed of wood and wax under good town clothes. It keeps its rounds, gives the hour in a fair voice, and strikes when the street is empty.

text: A fowl of ill temper with a serpent's tail, whose bite turns flesh to stone by degrees. The menagerie bred them for the yard, and the yard has been theirs for an age.
translated: A fowl of ill temper with a serpent's tail, whose bite turns flesh to 石 by degrees. The menagerie bred them for the yard, and the yard has been theirs for an age.

text: Eagle before and lion behind, proud and carnivorous. The menagerie's stock has hunted its own galleries for a thousand years and knows every perch in the dark.
translated: Eagle before and lion behind, proud and carnivorous. The menagerie's stock has hunted its own galleries for a thousand years and knows every perch in the dark.

text: A bull plated in iron scales, whose breath settles upon the skin as stone. It was the pride of the collection, and its cage stands open with the rest.
translated: A bull plated in iron scales, whose breath settles upon the skin as 石. It was the pride of the collection, and its cage stands open with the rest.

text: A copyist of the scriptorium kept at the desk past its dying, bone and long habit under an inked cuff. It writes the same fair hand it wrote in life, and it takes up the pen as a weapon when the copying is disturbed.
translated: A copyist of the scriptorium kept at the desk past its dying, bone and long habit under an inked cuff. It writes the same fair hand it wrote in life, and it takes up the pen as a weapon when the copying is disturbed.

text: The scriptorium's ink, pooled and self-willed after an age in the warm channels. It takes the shape of whatever was last written in it, and it writes upon flesh as readily as vellum.
translated: The scriptorium's ink, pooled and self-willed after an age in the warm channels. It takes the shape of whatever was last written in it, and it writes upon flesh as readily as vellum.

text: A construct of ladder, lamp and grasping arms, built to keep the stacks in order. It files intruders where they will disturb no shelving, and the stacks hold what it has filed.
translated: A construct of ladder, lamp and grasping arms, built to keep the stacks in order. It files intruders where they will disturb no shelving, and the stacks hold what it has filed.

text: A spell set running centuries ago and never dismissed, pacing its old circuit as a beast paces a cage. It has forgotten its purpose and kept its force entire.
translated: A 法术 set running centuries ago and never dismissed, pacing its old circuit as a 野兽 paces a cage. It has forgotten its purpose and kept its force entire.

text: A reflection walked out of its mirror, cold to the touch and correct in every particular but the eyes. It wants the rest of what it shows.
translated: A reflection walked out of its mirror, cold to the touch and correct in every particular but the eyes. It wants the rest of what it shows.

text: The unquiet remainder of one who died in the halls and was catalogued rather than buried. Its touch draws the warmth from the living, and doors are nothing to it.
translated: The unquiet remainder of one who died in the halls and was catalogued rather than buried. Its touch draws the warmth from the living, and doors are nothing to it.

text: A hunting shape of living quicksilver that runs the gallery floors between the mirrors. A blade passes through it and leaves a ripple, and it gathers itself again with the teeth foremost.
translated: A hunting shape of living quicksilver that runs the gallery floors between the mirrors. A blade passes through it and leaves a ripple, and it gathers itself again with the teeth foremost.

text: A woman crowned with serpents, whose gaze is death in stone. The figures in her gallery stand in attitudes of flight, and the newest of them are travellers the survey has on its rolls.
translated: A woman crowned with serpents, whose gaze is death in 石. The figures in her gallery stand in attitudes of flight, and the newest of them are travellers the survey has on its rolls.

text: A servant of poured wax, child-sized, winged after the fashion of a bat and warm to the touch. It runs the master's errands still, and some of the errands are for blood.
translated: A servant of poured wax, child-sized, winged after the fashion of a bat and warm to the touch. It runs the master's errands still, and some of the errands are for blood.

text: A man assembled from men, sewn and quickened upon the foundry's tables. It obeys the last order it was given, and the last order was to keep the tables clear.
translated: A man assembled from men, sewn and quickened upon the foundry's tables. It obeys the last order it was given, and the last order was to keep the tables clear.

text: A casting quickened before its finishing, one arm short and its face left smooth. It works at its own assembly between watches, with whatever parts come to hand.
translated: A casting quickened before its finishing, one arm short and its face left smooth. It works at its own assembly between watches, with whatever parts come to hand.

text: The foundry's masterwork in dressed stone, patient as its quarry. It stands among the statuary until the floor trembles, and then the statuary walks.
translated: The foundry's masterwork in dressed 石, patient as its quarry. It stands among the statuary until the 楼层 trembles, and then the statuary walks.

text: A warden of the observatory glass, hook-beaked and sharp of eye, set to keep the lenses clean and the stair clear. It has watched you since the Guildhouse step, and what it sees, the observatory sees.
translated: A warden of the observatory glass, hook-beaked and sharp of eye, set to keep the lenses clean and the stair clear. It has watched you since the 行会大厅 step, and what it sees, the observatory sees.

text: An arm of the observatory's great model, drawn off its pivot and gone walking down the gallery. It keeps the sweep it was cut for, turning upon nothing at the height of a man's chest, and it cuts what stands in the arc.
translated: An arm of the observatory's great model, drawn off its pivot and gone walking down the gallery. It keeps the sweep it was cut for, turning upon nothing at the height of a man's chest, and it cuts what stands in the 幕.

text: A copy of the master, poured and quickened and judged wanting, turned out into the halls to shift for itself. It remembers the workings and the grievance both.
translated: A copy of the master, poured and quickened and judged wanting, turned out into the halls to shift for itself. It remembers the workings and the grievance both.

text: The last and heaviest of the foundry's issue, set to keep the observatory door. It has stood its post since the pouring, and its orders admit no callers.
translated: The last and heaviest of the foundry's issue, set to keep the observatory door. It has stood its post since the pouring, and its orders admit no callers.

text: A hand of the Roll risen from the enrolling stool, still in the grey livery of the court. It carries the volume it was entered in, and it comes at a caller with the whole weight of the names that volume holds.
translated: A hand of the Roll risen from the enrolling stool, still in the grey livery of the court. It carries the volume it was entered in, and it comes at a caller with the whole weight of the names that volume holds.

text: A small foul thing of the sealing-works, condensed out of the steam the drum drives back against the wound. It rides the gauge-lines and bursts when it is broken, and the burst carries the heat of the works with it.
translated: A small foul thing of the sealing-works, condensed out of the steam the drum drives back against the wound. It rides the gauge-lines and bursts when it is broken, and the burst carries the heat of the works with it.

text: A warden of the unwritten floor, correct in every particular and empty of any mark. It keeps the blank stone as a clerk keeps a page, and it takes the record off whatever crosses it.
translated: A warden of the unwritten 楼层, correct in every particular and empty of any mark. It keeps the blank 石 as a clerk keeps a page, and it takes the record off whatever crosses it.

text: A crow grown large and bold upon the gibbets of the moor road, black to the beak and heavy in the air. It attends the living rather than the dead, and it calls its fellows down the moment a traveller stumbles.
translated: A crow grown large and bold upon the gibbets of the moor road, black to the beak and heavy in the air. It attends the living rather than the dead, and it calls its fellows down the moment a traveller stumbles.

text: A lean rat-kin of the open moor, peat-black and long in the limb, that works the road for whatever the traveller drops. It comes at a walker from behind and low, and it takes the pack before it takes the man.
translated: A lean rat-kin of the open moor, peat-black and long in the limb, that works the road for whatever the traveller drops. It comes at a walker from behind and low, and it takes the pack before it takes the man.

text: A bat with the wingspan of a hunting bird, roosting in the crag caves above the moor road. It hunts by ear alone, and it strikes at a swinging lantern before it strikes at the hand that carries it.
translated: A bat with the wingspan of a hunting bird, roosting in the crag caves above the moor road. It hunts by ear alone, and it strikes at a swinging lantern before it strikes at the hand that carries it.

text: What remains of a traveller who died at a waystone and was entered in no parish book. It keeps to its own stone, it asks the road of whoever passes, and it takes a wrong answer for an injury.
translated: What remains of a traveller who died at a waystone and was entered in no parish book. It keeps to its own 石, it asks the road of whoever passes, and it takes a wrong answer for an injury.

text: A man of the Vale who takes the shape of a rat at need and keeps the cunning of the man in either shape. It runs the drains and the thatch of Hollowmere, and it carries word up the crag for the price of being let alone.
translated: A man of the Vale who takes the shape of a rat at need and keeps the cunning of the man in either shape. It runs the drains and the thatch of Hollowmere, and it carries word up the crag for the price of being let alone.

text: A herdsman of the Vale in the shape of a great bear, red-eyed and thick in the shoulder, that keeps to the crag pastures above the village. It comes out of the scrub at a run and bears a man down under its weight.
translated: A herdsman of the Vale in the shape of a great bear, red-eyed and thick in the shoulder, that keeps to the crag pastures above the village. It comes out of the scrub at a run and bears a man down under its weight.

text: A brute of the castle kennels, kept in the runs on a short chain and fed what the hunt left. It came down into the village lanes when the house was buried, and it keeps the lanes yet, collared still.
translated: A brute of the castle kennels, kept in the runs on a short chain and fed what the hunt left. It came down into the village lanes when the house was buried, and it keeps the lanes yet, collared still.

text: A taller blight of the Thornwake, pine-needled and the height of a man, that looses its needles in a volley at ten paces. A stand of them fires together, and the volley comes from both sides of the ride at once.
translated: A taller blight of the Thornwake, pine-needled and the height of a man, that looses its needles in a volley at ten paces. A stand of them fires together, and the volley comes from both sides of the ride at once.

text: A foul bird-thing of the drowned wood with a woman's face and a voice to match, that hunts the Thornwake in threes. It sings the road quiet before it stoops, and it goes for the eyes of a standing man.
translated: A foul bird-thing of the drowned wood with a woman's face and a voice to match, that hunts the Thornwake in threes. It sings the road quiet before it stoops, and it goes for the eyes of a standing man.

text: A gallows of grown thorn, raised where the wood took a hanged man and kept him. It has the reach of the branch and the strength of the trunk, and it lifts whatever it takes clear of the ground before it closes.
translated: A gallows of grown thorn, raised where the wood took a hanged man and kept him. It has the reach of the branch and the strength of the trunk, and it lifts whatever it takes clear of the ground before it closes.

text: The remains of one of the abbey's lay brothers, kept at the pruning of the grave-trees. It works the rows in their numbered order and takes up its hook against whoever stands between it and the next tree.
translated: The remains of one of the abbey's lay brothers, kept at the pruning of the grave-trees. It works the rows in their numbered order and takes up its hook against whoever stands between it and the next tree.

text: A hyena-headed scavenger of the burying-ground, come down out of the hills to the easiest meat in the Vale. It hunts in threes and fours, it digs where the ground is soft, and it fights its own kind over what it digs.
translated: A hyena-headed scavenger of the burying-ground, come down out of the hills to the easiest meat in the Vale. It hunts in threes and fours, it digs where the ground is soft, and it fights its own kind over what it digs.

text: A small winged thing of the grave-orchard, no longer than a hand and armed with a thorn. It shoots from the branches at the eye and the throat, and the lime of the orchard lies upon its wings and burns where it settles.
translated: A small winged thing of the grave-orchard, no longer than a hand and armed with a thorn. It shoots from the branches at the eye and the throat, and the lime of the orchard lies upon its wings and burns where it settles.

text: A brother of Saint Ordel who died with his confession unheard and rose again the same night. It comes upon the living with its hands open, asking the office it was refused, and it treats every refusal as the first.
translated: A brother of Saint Ordel who died with his confession unheard and rose again the same night. It comes upon the living with its hands open, asking the office it was refused, and it treats every refusal as the first.

text: One of the wedding party that walked into Ysmere behind its bride, risen in the linen it drowned in. It keeps to the shallows and reaches for the hand of whoever comes down to the water's edge.
translated: One of the wedding party that walked into Ysmere behind its bride, risen in the linen it drowned in. It keeps to the shallows and reaches for the hand of whoever comes down to the water's edge.

text: A cold shape among the black reeds with the outline of a woman and the substance of a draught. Its touch takes the warmth out of a limb and leaves it dead to the shoulder, and the reeds close behind it unbent.
translated: A cold shape among the black reeds with the outline of a woman and the substance of a draught. Its touch takes the warmth out of a limb and leaves it dead to the shoulder, and the reeds close behind it unbent.

text: A moving heap of fen-thatch and rotted reed, taller than a man and heavier than three. It smothers rather than strikes, and both rain and lightning feed it, and the Vale provides a great deal of the first.
translated: A moving heap of fen-thatch and rotted reed, taller than a man and heavier than three. It smothers rather than strikes, and both rain and lightning feed it, and the Vale provides a great deal of the first.

text: A hound of the Corvane kennels, silver-collared and bred long past any natural line. It hunts silent and gives tongue only at the kill, and the whole pack answers the horn from any quarter of the Vale.
translated: A hound of the Corvane kennels, silver-collared and bred long past any natural line. It hunts silent and gives tongue only at the kill, and the whole pack answers the horn from any quarter of the Vale.

text: A small fiend of the curtain wall, horned and barbed and quick as a bat in the dark. It goes out of sight between one step and the next, and it comes back inside the guard of the man it left.
translated: A small fiend of the curtain wall, horned and barbed and quick as a bat in the dark. It goes out of sight between one step and the next, and it comes back inside the guard of the man it left.

text: An eagle before and a horse behind, nesting upon the curtain wall of the buried house. It stoops upon whatever crosses the open ground below the wall, and it carries what it takes back to the nest to be dealt with there.
translated: An eagle before and a horse behind, nesting upon the curtain wall of the buried house. It stoops upon whatever crosses the open ground below the wall, and it carries what it takes back to the nest to be dealt with there.

text: One of the women of Hollowmere taken up the crag and kept, risen pale and quick and bound to the house. She is met upon the great stair in marriage-lace, and she asks whether you have come for the wedding.
translated: One of the women of Hollowmere taken up the crag and kept, risen pale and quick and bound to the house. She is met upon the great stair in marriage-lace, and she asks whether you have come for the wedding.

text: A fiend of the castle's upper rooms that visits the sleeping and takes what it needs a little at a time. It wears whatever face the sleeper trusts, and it has had three hundred years to learn which faces those are.
translated: A fiend of the castle's upper rooms that visits the sleeping and takes what it needs a little at a time. It wears whatever face the sleeper trusts, and it has had three hundred years to learn which faces those are.

text: Strike for the haunches and keep your thumbs from the teeth. The tail is bought whole; a tail in pieces is bought as pieces.
translated: Strike for the haunches and keep your thumbs from the teeth. The tail is bought whole; a tail in pieces is bought as pieces.

text: It throws four stones and then it runs. Close upon the fifth count and take the tooth unmarked.
translated: It throws four stones and then it runs. 关闭 upon the fifth count and take the tooth unmarked.

text: Carry the torch at arm's length from the body, for the stirge strikes at warmth. Take it upon the backswing, as it lifts.
translated: Carry the torch at arm's length from the body, for the stirge strikes at warmth. Take it upon the backswing, as it lifts.

text: It hates the torch and watches the torch, so let the torch do the feinting. Members schooled in Witchlight report the beast follows the light wherever the light is sent.
translated: It hates the torch and watches the torch, so let the torch do the feinting. Members schooled in Witchlight report the 野兽 follows the light wherever the light is sent.

text: The first rush is the whole of its plan. Give ground one pace, let the rush spend itself, and finish the matter upon the turn.
translated: The first rush is the whole of its plan. Give ground one pace, let the rush spend itself, and finish the matter upon the turn.

text: They fight for the midden and break off when the midden is fired, so put a torch to the heap and take them as they scatter. Sound pieces of gnawed bone are bought by the piece, so take the whole ones.
translated: They fight for the midden and break off when the midden is fired, so put a torch to the heap and take them as they scatter. Sound pieces of gnawed bone are bought by the piece, so take the whole ones.

text: Cross open ground upon a slant, and the crooked arrows cross behind you. The heads of snapped arrows are bought by the dozen at the counter.
translated: Cross open ground upon a slant, and the crooked arrows cross behind you. The heads of snapped arrows are bought by the dozen at the 商店.

text: It circles to the blind side by habit, and offers the throat upon the second circle. The Steady Hand, held ready, makes that offer final.
translated: It circles to the blind side by habit, and offers the throat upon the second circle. The Steady Hand, 持有 ready, makes that offer final.

text: It fights by the drill-book, and the book keeps no page for a broken rank. Fell the right-hand man of the file and the file spends its discipline reforming.
translated: It fights by the drill-book, and the book keeps no page for a broken rank. Fell the right-hand man of the file and the file spends its discipline reforming.

text: The charge comes first and it comes in earnest; meet it braced or meet it twice. The jaw is weighed at the counter with the tusks in it, so draw no teeth upon the road.
translated: The charge comes first and it comes in earnest; meet it braced or meet it twice. The jaw is weighed at the 商店 with the tusks in it, so draw no teeth upon the road.

text: Carry the pole before you at head height and the snares announce themselves upon it. Choose your footing before you burn a single strand.
translated: Carry the pole before you at head height and the snares announce themselves upon it. Choose your footing before you burn a single strand.

text: It fights before an audience, and it treats without one. Bar the gallery door first, and the treating begins at once.
translated: It fights before an audience, and it treats without one. Bar the gallery door first, and the treating begins at once.

text: Spare the edge and use the flat, or a mace, at the hip. The Dead Tongue, spoken as the bones rise, unbinds the older sort a stroke early.
translated: Spare the edge and use the flat, or a 钉头锤, at the hip. The Dead Tongue, spoken as the bones rise, unbinds the older sort a stroke early.

text: It follows the last sound it heard, and a thrown stone is a sound. Spend the quiet you buy upon the neck, which is the whole of the work.
translated: It follows the last sound it heard, and a thrown 石 is a sound. Spend the quiet you buy upon the neck, which is the whole of the work.

text: Keep the bracers high; the paralysis rides in the claw and enters at the bare forearm. Members who hold Sing Them Down report the stiffness passes the sooner.
translated: Keep the bracers high; the paralysis rides in the claw and enters at the bare forearm. Members who hold Sing Them Down report the stiffness passes the sooner.

text: Its orders are its whole mind, and the orders name a post. Draw it three paces off the post and its footwork stays behind; gather every rivet, for the rivets are the proof.
translated: Its orders are its whole mind, and the orders name a post. Draw it three paces off the post and its footwork stays behind; gather every rivet, for the rivets are the proof.

text: Burn the egg-sacs first or fight her twice. The silk takes a fair price cut dry and rolled; folded silk is bought as rag.
translated: Burn the egg-sacs first or fight her twice. The silk takes a fair price cut dry and rolled; folded silk is bought as rag.

text: The chill climbs the weapon, so wrap the grip in wool and change hands by turns. The signet is pried off cold and entered at the counter under seal.
translated: The chill climbs the weapon, so wrap the grip in wool and change hands by turns. The signet is pried off cold and entered at the 商店 under seal.

text: The stench arrives two rooms ahead of it; trust the nose over the ear and stand where the air moves. Keep the Old Things Off, held ready, makes the reek bearable and the paralysis brief.
translated: The stench arrives two rooms 前方 of it; trust the nose over the ear and stand where the air moves. Keep the Old Things Off, 持有 ready, makes the reek bearable and the paralysis brief.

text: Sound the perches with the pole as you pass: stone rings, and a gargoyle thuds. Smell the Working tells the live stone from the dead at ten paces.
translated: Sound the perches with the pole as you pass: 石 rings, and a gargoyle thuds. Smell the Working tells the live 石 from the dead at ten paces.

text: Fix the road before the light shows itself, then walk the road and only the road. A wisp tires of a traveller who keeps a straight line, and a tired wisp sinks low enough to strike.
translated: Fix the road before the light shows itself, then walk the road and only the road. A wisp tires of a traveller who keeps a straight line, and a tired wisp sinks low enough to strike.

text: There is no quiet road past an owlbear, and the Guild has stopped paying for accounts of one. Take the first charge upon a pillar, and the second charge is yours to give.
translated: There is no quiet road past an owlbear, and the 行会 has stopped paying for accounts of one. Take the first charge upon a pillar, and the second charge is yours to give.

text: The club telegraphs from the shoulder, so watch the shoulder and spend the swing. The knuckle is bought whole, by weight, and the weighing draws a crowd.
translated: The 棍棒 telegraphs from the shoulder, so watch the shoulder and spend the swing. The knuckle is bought whole, by weight, and the weighing draws a crowd.

text: Plain steel passes through it; silvered or rune-etched work bites. The Dead Tongue, spoken plainly, holds it at arm's length for the length of the speaking.
translated: Plain steel passes through it; 镀银 or rune-etched work bites. The Dead Tongue, spoken plainly, holds it at arm's length for the length of the speaking.

text: Fire, or the work is rented. A troll entered in the ledger without a burning is entered as pending, and the Guild sends an auditor after the word.
translated: Fire, or the work is rented. A troll entered in the ledger without a burning is entered as pending, and the 行会 sends an auditor after the word.

text: Watch the feet in the polish of your shield and never the head. The eye keeps its virtue a week in honey, and the counter sells honey for this reason.
translated: Watch the feet in the polish of your 盾牌 and never the head. The eye keeps its virtue a week in honey, and the 商店 sells honey for this reason.

text: Count the spikes as they fly: the tail carries four and twenty, and a spent manticore must land to fight. Gather the spikes, for the spikes are the trophy and the proof.
translated: Count the spikes as they fly: the tail carries four and twenty, and a spent manticore must land to fight. Gather the spikes, for the spikes are the 战利品 and the proof.

text: The heads quarrel over precedence at the first wound, so wound it early and keep the middle distance while they settle it. The settling is the opening.
translated: The heads quarrel over precedence at the first wound, so wound it early and keep the middle distance while they settle it. The settling is the opening.

text: Never contest the ground it chooses; bring it onto the stair, where its own weight does the Guild's work. The thumb is taken last, and with the axe.
translated: Never contest the ground it chooses; bring it onto the stair, where its own weight does the 行会's work. The thumb is taken last, and with the axe.

text: The cold runs ahead of the breath: when the passage frosts, step wide and count three. Pry the scales cold, for a scale pried warm curls.
translated: The cold runs 前方 of the breath: when the passage frosts, step wide and count three. Pry the scales cold, for a scale pried warm curls.

text: It will offer terms, and the terms are the trap. Decline in silence, and hold your breath through the first green cloud, which is the answer to the declining.
translated: It will offer terms, and the terms are the trap. Decline in silence, and hold your breath through the first green cloud, which is the answer to the declining.

text: Three heads and one belly, and all three answer when the belly is threatened. Feint low: the goat takes the feint first, and the goat is the honest head.
translated: Three heads and one belly, and all three answer when the belly is threatened. Feint low: the goat takes the feint first, and the goat is the honest head.

text: Listen for the drip of venom, which arrives ahead of the wings. Cut the gland standing well behind the sting, and never squeeze it.
translated: Listen for the drip of venom, which arrives 前方 of the wings. Cut the gland standing well behind the sting, and never squeeze it.

text: Learn the name of its quarry and stand out of the road between them, for it spends no stroke on bystanders. The grudge is filed at the counter as found; the Guild keeps a drawer.
translated: Learn the name of its quarry and stand out of the road between them, for it spends no stroke on bystanders. The grudge is filed at the 商店 as found; the 行会 keeps a drawer.

text: In the open dark it is swift past all parrying, so make it come to the lamp, and the lamp evens the account. Tell-Tale Glow marks the fang worth the taking.
translated: In the open dark it is swift past all parrying, so make it come to the lamp, and the lamp evens the account. Tell-Tale Glow marks the fang worth the taking.

text: The acid falls and pools, and the pools keep their virtue for an hour: mark them, and fight between them. Boots are on the Guild's account for members upon this floor.
translated: The acid falls and pools, and the pools keep their virtue for an hour: mark them, and fight between them. Boots are on the 行会's account for members upon this 楼层.

text: Sound the ceiling with the pole before the torch goes under it. A dropped darkmantle smothers the light first, so carry the second candle lit and behind you.
translated: Sound the ceiling with the pole before the torch goes under it. A dropped darkmantle smothers the light first, so carry the second candle lit and behind you.

text: Ground your weapons ten paces back and go in with the torch and a stone club. Members who feed it a spare buckle report it follows the buckle, and the feeler is taken while it dines.
translated: Ground your weapons ten paces back and go in with the torch and a 石 棍棒. Members who feed it a spare buckle report it follows the buckle, and the feeler is taken while it dines.

text: It will die for the burden, so take the burden question off the table: pin the pack-strap to the wall and the bearer fights like any goblin. The sliver goes to the counter in the tongs provided, and never in a pocket.
translated: It will die for the burden, so take the burden question off the table: pin the pack-strap to the wall and the bearer fights like any goblin. The sliver goes to the 商店 in the tongs provided, and never in a pocket.

text: Walk the corridors pole-first, always: the pole comes back wet, and cheap. What the cube keeps, the cube has priced for you; cut the buckle out from the back face and let the front keep its patience.
translated: Walk the corridors pole-first, always: the pole comes back wet, and cheap. What the cube keeps, the cube has priced for you; cut the buckle out from the back face and let the front keep its patience.

text: Stand still and it reads you anyway: heartbeat, breath, the creak of your straps. Walk upon wet stone, speak plainly to cover your gear, and take the rush upon the off-side, where its ear judges worst.
translated: Stand still and it reads you anyway: heartbeat, breath, the creak of your straps. Walk upon wet 石, speak plainly to cover your gear, and take the rush upon the off-side, where its ear judges worst.

text: Its reach is a pace longer than any honest measure of its arms, so chalk your distance and add one. The ambush is always at the second door, never the first; the Guild has paid for the counting.
translated: Its reach is a pace longer than any honest measure of its arms, so chalk your distance and add one. The ambush is always at the second door, never the first; the 行会 has paid for the counting.

text: It fights half here and half at the standing stone, and the half here is slow. Break the chalk in its hand early, and Keep the Old Things Off, held ready, keeps its dreams from leaning on yours.
translated: It fights half here and half at the standing 石, and the half here is slow. Break the chalk in its hand early, and Keep the Old Things Off, 持有 ready, keeps its dreams from leaning on yours.

text: Count its flock before you touch a single strand, for the shepherd answers the fence-wire faster than the sheep. Fire ruins the silk and the silk is the pay; cut dry, roll tight.
translated: Count its flock before you touch a single strand, for the shepherd answers the fence-wire faster than the sheep. Fire ruins the silk and the silk is the pay; cut dry, roll tight.

text: The harpoon comes at the lantern-bearer first, every time, so the lantern rides a pole upon the gunwale. Cut the line before you contest the pull; the tarn wins every tug of war.
translated: The harpoon comes at the lantern-bearer first, every time, so the lantern rides a pole upon the gunwale. Cut the line before you contest the pull; the tarn wins every tug of war.

text: It strikes from the basin it is bound to, and its binding names the basin, never the road beside it. Read the old orders aloud if you can find them: members report it stands down for the length of the reading.
translated: It strikes from the basin it is bound to, and its binding names the basin, never the road beside it. Read the old orders aloud if you can find them: members report it stands down for the length of the reading.

text: Count the cloaks upon any peg-rail you pass, and count again on the way out. Its moan unmans the unready, so plug one ear with wax and keep the other for your party.
translated: Count the cloaks upon any peg-rail you pass, and count again on the way out. Its moan unmans the unready, so plug one ear with wax and keep the other for your party.

text: It takes the armoured arm first, reckoning it the threat, so offer the shield-side and pay it in wood. The pincer opens at the joint to a pry-bar, and nothing else the Guild has shipped.
translated: It takes the armoured arm first, reckoning it the threat, so offer the 盾牌-side and pay it in wood. The pincer opens at the joint to a pry-bar, and nothing else the 行会 has shipped.

text: It is the deep's doorbell, and killing it rings it. Shade the lantern to a slit, walk the bed's far edge, and if it cries anyway, stand and meet what comes rather than be met running.
translated: It is the deep's doorbell, and killing it rings it. Shade the lantern to a slit, walk the bed's far edge, and if it cries anyway, stand and meet what comes rather than be met running.

text: The wet patch of floor with no drip above it is the ooze. Steel feeds it; deal in stone and fire, and enter ruined kit against the Guild's insurance the same day.
translated: The wet patch of 楼层 with no drip above it is the ooze. Steel feeds it; deal in 石 and fire, and enter ruined kit against the 行会's insurance the same day.

text: Never fight it in its midden, for the ground is its oldest ally. Bait it two rooms upwind with the ration nobody wanted, and mind the third leg: the kick comes from it.
translated: Never fight it in its midden, for the ground is its oldest ally. Bait it two rooms upwind with the ration nobody wanted, and mind the third leg: the kick comes from it.

text: Break the whistle and the gang stops working; some of the gang remembers who it was, and the overseer knows it, and grows careless in the hurry. Silence the whistle first and the rest is drill-book.
translated: Break the whistle and the gang stops 法术; some of the gang remembers who it was, and the overseer knows it, and grows careless in the hurry. Silence the whistle first and the rest is drill-book.

text: It fights from the ceiling of its own grief and hurries for nothing. Foul the anchor-lines high on the wall before the first arrow, and it must come down to you, where the drill against spiders serves.
translated: It fights from the ceiling of its own grief and hurries for nothing. Foul the anchor-lines high on the wall before the first arrow, and it must come down to you, where the drill against spiders serves.

text: Report the flow's width to the member behind you before you do anything else about it. It pours downhill and through gratings, so hold the high ground and spend fire; a blade given to it is a donation.
translated: Report the flow's width to the member behind you before you do anything else about it. It pours downhill and through gratings, so hold the high ground and spend fire; a blade given to it is a donation.

text: Wax in both ears, chalk arrows before the ground goes soft, and one member told off to watch boots and nothing else. The babble borrows voices you know; the Guild's advice is written, for this floor, on paper.
translated: Wax in both ears, chalk arrows before the ground goes soft, and one member told off to watch 靴子 and nothing else. The babble borrows voices you know; the 行会's advice is written, for this 楼层, on paper.

text: Flour, dust, or the fine grey spore of the vaults: throw it high and fight the shape the air makes. It leaves upon the instant its errand is done, so the surest defence is learning what was asked of it.
translated: Flour, dust, or the fine grey spore of the vaults: throw it high and fight the shape the air makes. It leaves upon the instant its errand is 完成, so the surest defence is learning what was asked of it.

text: Its first working is always the one that holds you still, so break the eye-line at the first syllable. The fang is drawn with the grain and paid at the counter under bond, against the owner's return.
translated: Its first 法术 is always the one that holds you still, so break the eye-line at the first syllable. The fang is drawn with the grain and paid at the 商店 under bond, against the owner's return.

text: Touch nothing in the halls with a bare hand until it has been touched with the pole. The tongue-tip is bought dried, and the drying is the seller's own affair.
translated: Touch nothing in the halls with a bare hand until it has been touched with the pole. The tongue-tip is bought dried, and the drying is the seller's own affair.

text: Agree a password with your party before entering the town, and use it upon everyone you know. The face is carried to the counter face-down, and Master Pell turns it over once, for the record.
translated: Agree a password with your party before entering the town, and use it upon everyone you know. The face is carried to the 商店 face-down, and Master Pell turns it over once, for the record.

text: The townsfolk below give the hour when asked, and the counterfeit gives it seven minutes early, upon the false bell. Ask, then strike upon the answer.
translated: The townsfolk below give the hour when asked, and the counterfeit gives it seven minutes early, upon the false bell. Ask, then strike upon the answer.

text: Let it read its warrant entire: the mainspring drives the reading or the truncheon, never both at once. The matter is settled from behind the shoulder while the law is being observed.
translated: Let it read its warrant entire: the mainspring drives the reading or the truncheon, never both at once. The matter is settled from behind the shoulder while the law is being observed.

text: The bite stones a limb by degrees, and the degrees can be outrun: bind above the bite, keep the limb below the heart, and climb. The tailfeather is drawn from the dead bird at the counter's price.
translated: The bite stones a limb by degrees, and the degrees can be outrun: bind above the bite, keep the limb below the heart, and climb. The tailfeather is drawn from the dead bird at the 商店's price.

text: It stoops from behind the lamps, so hood the lantern at the cage-rows and listen for the rasp of feather upon brass. A wing-feather in fair condition is bought for the fletchers by the piece.
translated: It stoops from behind the lamps, so hood the lantern at the cage-rows and listen for the rasp of feather upon brass. A wing-feather in fair condition is bought for the fletchers by the piece.

text: Silent at the course and alight at the last length: when the straw smokes, throw yourself flat and cut upward. Draw the fang with tongs and carry it in sand, for the heat outlasts the beast by a day.
translated: Silent at the course and alight at the last length: when the straw smokes, throw yourself flat and cut upward. Draw the fang with tongs and carry it in sand, for the heat outlasts the 野兽 by a day.

text: The breath falls as a fog and settles grey: hold the breath you own, work upwind, and strike behind the foreleg where the plates part. The scales are bought by weight and want no polishing.
translated: The breath falls as a fog and settles grey: hold the breath you own, work upwind, and strike behind the foreleg where the plates part. The scales are bought by weight and want no polishing.

text: It must finish the line it is upon before it turns, so strike upon the turn. Spill the ink and it stops to blot. The inked cuff is bought at the counter as evidence of the hand.
translated: It must finish the line it is upon before it turns, so strike upon the turn. Spill the ink and it stops to blot. The inked cuff is bought at the 商店 as evidence of the hand.

text: It must keep to its channels or dry, so draw it out upon the dry flags and let the floor do half the work. The phial is filled at arm's length and stoppered wet.
translated: It must keep to its channels or dry, so draw it out upon the dry flags and let the 楼层 do half the work. The phial is filled at arm's length and stoppered wet.

text: It strikes no body that is reshelving: carry a book, carry it visibly, and put it back wrong. While the warden rights your error, the matter is settled from behind.
translated: It strikes no body that is reshelving: carry a book, carry it visibly, and put it back wrong. While the warden rights your error, the matter is settled from behind.

text: It keeps its circuit to the minute, and the survey has the timetable. Stand aside for its passing and take it at the turn, where the old dismissal was cut to catch it.
translated: It keeps its circuit to the minute, and the survey has the timetable. Stand aside for its passing and take it at the turn, where the old dismissal was cut to catch it.

text: Stand at the lamp with it: your eyes water and the double's stay dry. Strike the dry-eyed one, and let the true reflection find its own way back to the glass.
translated: Stand at the lamp with it: your eyes water and the double's stay dry. Strike the dry-eyed one, and let the true reflection find its own way back to the glass.

text: Iron and courtesy both pass through it, and the old rites alone give it pause. Members without a working of the rites keep a wall at their back and their business brief.
translated: Iron and courtesy both pass through it, and the old rites alone give it pause. Members without a 法术 of the rites keep a wall at their back and their business brief.

text: The blade parts it and buys one breath while it gathers: spend the breath on ground, never on a second stroke. The bead is taken up with a horn spoon and never with the fingers.
translated: The blade parts it and buys one breath while it gathers: spend the breath on ground, never on a second stroke. The bead is taken up with a horn spoon and never with the fingers.

text: Work by the mirrors, for the galleries are hung with them by an arrangement the collection respects. The hair is cut with shears, coiled with the grain, and boxed before it stills.
translated: Work by the mirrors, for the galleries are hung with them by an arrangement the collection respects. The hair is cut with shears, coiled with the grain, and boxed before it stills.

text: Warm it and it slows: herd it toward your own lamp and away from the cold air, and take the wing whole once the wax runs soft at the edges.
translated: Warm it and it slows: herd it toward your own lamp and away from the cold air, and take the wing whole once the wax runs soft at the edges.

text: It follows its last order to the letter, so change what the letter requires: clear the table where you stand and it stands down while you pass. Stitching is cut, never unpicked, and bought by the hand's-length.
translated: It follows its last order to the letter, so change what the letter requires: clear the table where you stand and it stands down while you pass. Stitching is cut, never unpicked, and bought by the hand's-length.

text: The unfinished side is the safe side: the smooth face keeps no eye and the short arm keeps no grip. Circle to its want of parts and work there.
translated: The unfinished side is the safe side: the smooth face keeps no eye and the short arm keeps no grip. Circle to its want of parts and work there.

text: Count the statuary at the door and count it again at the far arch, and the figure that has changed rank is the golem. The maul marks it where the sword rings off, so bring the maul.
translated: Count the statuary at the door and count it again at the far arch, and the figure that has changed rank is the golem. The 重锤 marks it where the sword rings off, so bring the 重锤.

text: Hood the lantern and it comes down the stair for a better look, and it comes down within reach. The lens is taken from its collar in a gloved hand. A warm lens is paid double while it still shows the last thing it saw.
translated: Hood the lantern and it comes down the stair for a better look, and it comes down within reach. The lens is taken from its collar in a gloved hand. A warm lens is paid double while it still shows the last thing it saw.

text: It keeps the sweep it was cut for, so learn the arc and stand inside it where the arm carries no edge. Dent the pivot and the sweep runs short. The gear is drawn from the joint, and it is the same gear every time.
translated: It keeps the sweep it was cut for, so learn the 幕 and stand inside it where the arm carries no edge. Dent the pivot and the sweep runs short. The gear is drawn from the joint, and it is the same gear every time.

text: Watch the left hand: it closes a heartbeat before every working lands, the master's own habit, poured true. Move upon the closing, and the working spends itself where you stood.
translated: Watch the left hand: it closes a heartbeat before every 法术 lands, the master's own habit, poured true. Move upon the closing, and the 法术 spends itself where you stood.

text: It swings the volume from the shoulder and is slow to recover it, so close upon the swing and stay inside the arc. The binding-leaf is bought by weight, less the weight of the words.
translated: It swings the volume from the shoulder and is slow to recover it, so close upon the swing and stay inside the 幕. The binding-leaf is bought by weight, less the weight of the words.

text: It fills the gallery wall to wall, so take the high ground of a stair or a sill and keep it in front of you. Steel comes back pitted from it. The rind is dried and glazed before it will keep.
translated: It fills the gallery wall to wall, so take the high ground of a stair or a sill and keep it in front of you. Steel comes back pitted from it. The rind is dried and glazed before it will keep.

text: It works upon what is written, so carry nothing written that you mean to keep, and set a blank leaf in its way instead. It stops to keep the blank leaf. The signature is bought uncut.
translated: It works upon what is written, so carry nothing written that you mean to keep, and set a blank leaf in its way instead. It stops to keep the blank leaf. The signature is bought uncut.

text: It comes up where the floor glows, so stand upon cold stone where the floor gives you the choice, and never stand still upon the warm. The molten plate is quenched before it will keep, and paid double.
translated: It comes up where the 楼层 glows, so stand upon cold 石 where the 楼层 gives you the choice, and never stand still upon the warm. The molten plate is quenched before it will keep, and paid double.

text: Work it onto dry stone if the ground gives you leave, for away from the wet it is slow and half-blind. The shell parts cleanly at the seam behind the head. The slick of shell is bought whole, so lift it in one piece.
translated: Work it onto dry 石 if the ground gives you leave, for away from the wet it is slow and half-blind. The shell parts cleanly at the seam behind the head. The slick of shell is bought whole, so lift it in one piece.

text: The plated back turns most blows; take it underneath, where the shale gives way to soft hide, and let the tremor pass before you close. A scute prised from the living plate is bought at a good price.
translated: The plated back turns most blows; take it underneath, where the shale gives way to soft hide, and let the tremor pass before you close. A scute prised from the living plate is bought at a good price.

text: Its wings will not bear it far from the cold. A torch held close drives it down, and the frost-dusted membrane tears at a touch once the beast is grounded. Take the wing entire, before the frost upon it melts.
translated: Its wings will not bear it far from the cold. A torch 持有 close drives it down, and the frost-dusted membrane tears at a touch once the 野兽 is grounded. Take the wing entire, before the frost upon it melts.

text: It strikes at the light and at the face, so set the lantern down at arm's length and fight beside it rather than behind it. The rasped tongue wants drying before it is packed, or it sours in a day.
translated: It strikes at the light and at the face, so set the lantern down at arm's length and fight beside it rather than behind it. The rasped tongue wants drying before it is packed, or it sours in a day.

text: They come in threes, and the third holds off until the pair have closed, so break the third first. A clean cast of the peat-caked pad is worth more to the north survey than the pad itself.
translated: They come in threes, and the third holds off until the pair have closed, so break the third first. A clean cast of the peat-caked pad is worth more to the north survey than the pad itself.

text: It goes for the pack before the man, so let the pack fall and take it while it stoops. The peat-black pelt is bought cured, and a torn one is bought at nothing.
translated: It goes for the pack before the man, so let the pack fall and take it while it stoops. The peat-black pelt is bought cured, and a torn one is bought at nothing.

text: It strikes at whatever swings, so put the lantern down and leave it burning, and take the beast over the top of it. The wing-joint is bought whole and will not bear folding.
translated: It strikes at whatever swings, so put the lantern down and leave it burning, and take the 野兽 over the top of it. The wing-joint is bought whole and will not bear folding.

text: Answer with a road it knew and it lets you by; answer with a lie and it follows you to the next stone. Take the rubbing in wax, for ink runs on that stone in any weather.
translated: Answer with a road it knew and it lets you by; answer with a lie and it follows you to the next 石. Take the rubbing in wax, for ink runs on that 石 in any 天气.

text: Stand still and it comes to you, which is the only ground of your choosing you will get. It goes out at the first heavy blow, so lead with the heaviest you carry.
translated: Stand still and it comes to you, which is the only ground of your choosing you will get. It goes out at the first heavy blow, so lead with the heaviest you carry.

text: Call it by its name off the doorpost and it stops for a breath, and a breath is enough. The shutter-bar is oak and heavy and worth carrying only in a light pack.
translated: Call it by its name off the doorpost and it stops for a breath, and a breath is enough. The shutter-bar is oak and heavy and worth carrying only in a light pack.

text: Silver, or the wound closes while you watch. It runs for the drains at half its strength, so put a body on the grate before you close.
translated: Silver, or the wound closes while you watch. It runs for the drains at half its strength, so put a body on the grate before you close.

text: Take the bell-rope out of his hand first and the whole office falls apart, for he cannot call the rest without it. The frayed end is bought by the fathom.
translated: Take the bell-rope out of his hand first and the whole office falls apart, for he cannot call the rest without it. The frayed end is bought by the fathom.

text: It works at close quarters and bears a man down, so keep the party spread and take it at the length of a spear. Silvered steel bites where plain steel slides. The clipped claw is bought by the pair.
translated: It works at close quarters and bears a man down, so keep the party spread and take it at the length of a 长矛. Silvered steel bites where plain steel slides. The clipped claw is bought by the pair.

text: Fire ruins the trophy and ends the fight, and the fight is the shorter matter, so use fire. Take the grey tallow from the base, where the wick was never lit.
translated: Fire ruins the 战利品 and ends the fight, and the fight is the shorter matter, so use fire. Take the grey tallow from the base, where the wick was never lit.

text: The chain is still upon it and fouls at a corner, so fight it where the lane turns and not in the open. The kennel collar is bought as evidence, not as leather.
translated: The chain is still upon it and fouls at a corner, so fight it where the lane turns and not in the open. The kennel collar is bought as evidence, not as leather.

text: They stand among the true thorn and are known by the root-knot they walk on, so watch the ground rather than the branch. Dry twig burns, and a stand of them clears in one draw of flame.
translated: They stand among the true thorn and are known by the root-knot they walk on, so watch the ground rather than the branch. Dry twig burns, and a stand of them clears in one draw of flame.

text: They loose together, so never cross a ride in the open where two stands can see you. The sheaf of needles is bought by the apothecary and must be carried in a stiff case.
translated: They loose together, so never cross a ride in the open where two stands can see you. The sheaf of needles is bought by the apothecary and must be carried in a stiff case.

text: The song comes before the stoop, so stop the ears of the party at the first note and keep moving under the boughs. The barred feather is bought by the piece and must be clean of blood.
translated: The song comes before the stoop, so stop the ears of the party at the first note and keep moving under the boughs. The barred feather is bought by the piece and must be clean of blood.

text: It lifts what it takes clear of the ground, so keep a blade loose at the belt where a lifted hand can still reach it. The thorn grown through the iron is cut out with the iron and sold together.
translated: It lifts what it takes clear of the ground, so keep a blade loose at the belt where a lifted hand can still reach it. The thorn grown through the iron is cut out with the iron and sold together.

text: Silver, and mind the horn, for a horn from the crag brings it in rather than driving it off. The seamless pelt is proof of the thing and is bought as proof.
translated: Silver, and mind the horn, for a horn from the crag brings it in rather than driving it off. The seamless pelt is proof of the thing and is bought as proof.

text: Bargain if you must and hold her to the letter, for she holds you to yours. Fighting her in her own water is the worst ground in the Vale; draw her onto the ride.
translated: Bargain if you must and hold her to the letter, for she holds you to yours. Fighting her in her own water is the worst ground in the Vale; draw her onto the ride.

text: It walks the rows and will not leave them, so break off across the ditch and it lets you go. Take it at the joint where the harness binds. The horn is bought whole and is worth nothing split.
translated: It walks the rows and will not leave them, so break off across the ditch and it lets you go. Take it at the joint where the harness binds. The horn is bought whole and is worth nothing split.

text: It works the rows in their numbered order, so stand in a row it has already cut and it passes you by. The rusted hook is bought as abbey work and wants no cleaning.
translated: It works the rows in their numbered order, so stand in a row it has already cut and it passes you by. The rusted hook is bought as abbey work and wants no cleaning.

text: They quarrel over the dig, so wait for the quarrel and take them apart in it. They will not follow past the wall. The scavenged jawbone is bought by the piece.
translated: They quarrel over the dig, so wait for the quarrel and take them apart in it. They will not follow past the wall. The scavenged jawbone is bought by the piece.

text: They shoot from the branches, so keep under the walls and out of the rows where the boughs meet overhead. The limed wing is bought flat between two boards.
translated: They shoot from the branches, so keep under the walls and out of the rows where the boughs meet overhead. The limed wing is bought flat between two boards.

text: It comes on with open hands and takes any answer for a refusal, so do not slow for the asking. The unsigned absolution is bought by the abbey's old table and is worth reading first.
translated: It comes on with open hands and takes any answer for a refusal, so do not slow for the asking. The unsigned absolution is bought by the abbey's old table and is worth reading first.

text: Stop the ears of the party before you enter the row, for the cry is the whole of the fight. A keening stoppered in a jar is worth a season's wages to the Guild library.
translated: Stop the ears of the party before you enter the row, for the cry is the whole of the fight. A keening stoppered in a jar is worth a season's wages to the 行会 library.

text: Never take the guide it offers, and if you have taken it, leave the reeds by the way you came. Its jaw is bought as proof that the guide was refused.
translated: Never take the guide it offers, and if you have taken it, leave the reeds by the way you came. Its jaw is bought as proof that the guide was refused.

text: Do not look at her when she rises; take her by the sound of the water instead. The drowned looking-glass is bought whole and is never looked into on the road.
translated: Do not look at her when she rises; take her by the sound of the water instead. The drowned looking-glass is bought whole and is never looked into on the road.

text: It reaches for a hand, so give it a blade and keep the hand. The sodden ribbon dries out white and is bought by the ell.
translated: It reaches for a hand, so give it a blade and keep the hand. The sodden ribbon dries out white and is bought by the ell.

text: Its touch kills a limb to the shoulder, so fight it at length or not at all. A bundle of black reed keeps its cold for a day and is packed away from food.
translated: Its touch kills a limb to the shoulder, so fight it at length or not at all. A bundle of black reed keeps its cold for a day and is packed away from food.

text: Fire is no use and lightning is worse, for both feed it; cut it apart and scatter the parts. Fen-thatch is bought by weight and comes up light once dried.
translated: Fire is no use and lightning is worse, for both feed it; cut it apart and scatter the parts. Fen-thatch is bought by weight and comes up light once dried.

text: The hooves burn what they strike, so fight it off the turf, on stone or on standing water. A hoof-print burned into turf is lifted whole with the sod beneath it.
translated: The hooves burn what they strike, so fight it off the turf, on 石 or on standing water. A hoof-print burned into turf is lifted whole with the sod beneath it.

text: It gives tongue only at the kill, so the first you hear of the pack is the last warning you get; watch the ground and not the air. The silvered collar is Corvane work and is bought at the castle's rate.
translated: It gives tongue only at the kill, so the first you hear of the pack is the last warning you get; watch the ground and not the air. The 镀银 collar is Corvane work and is bought at the castle's rate.

text: It leaves the world to close, so strike the air where it went rather than the ground where it stood. The wisp of sulphur is stoppered at once or it is gone before the counter.
translated: It leaves the world to close, so strike the air where it went rather than the ground where it stood. The wisp of sulphur is stoppered at once or it is gone before the 商店.

text: It stoops from the wall and wants the open ground, so keep to the lee of the stonework and cross in short runs. The pinion is drawn from the nest and not from the bird.
translated: It stoops from the wall and wants the open ground, so keep to the lee of the stonework and cross in short runs. The pinion is drawn from the nest and not from the bird.

text: He challenges by the old form, and the old form is written on the gatehouse board; give it back word for word and he shoulders his arm. The frozen halberd is bought as it stands and never thawed.
translated: He challenges by the old form, and the old form is written on the gatehouse board; give it back word for word and he shoulders his arm. The frozen 戟 is bought as it stands and never thawed.

text: It hunts the cellars by scent, so leave the pack at the stair and go down light. The broken horn is bought by the pair, and only one is ever taken.
translated: It hunts the cellars by scent, so leave the pack at the stair and go down light. The broken horn is bought by the pair, and only one is ever taken.

text: Shut the runs behind you as you come up, for the pack comes in when he is pressed. The bitten glove is bought as kennel work and carries the round of the runs stitched into its cuff.
translated: Shut the runs behind you as you come up, for the pack comes in when he is pressed. The bitten glove is bought as kennel work and carries the round of the runs stitched into its cuff.

text: It says aloud what it reads, and what it reads is you, so keep the party quiet and let it talk. A nothic's weeping lid is bought sealed and is worth the whole floor's takings.
translated: It says aloud what it reads, and what it reads is you, so keep the party quiet and let it talk. A nothic's weeping lid is bought sealed and is worth the whole 楼层's takings.

text: It walks the same road every time, so learn the road and be somewhere else upon it. The cut canvas is bought as house goods and is priced by the face upon it.
translated: It walks the same road every time, so learn the road and be somewhere else upon it. The cut canvas is bought as house goods and is priced by the face upon it.

text: She asks a question at the head of the stair, and any answer at all is taken for yes; give none. Marriage-lace is bought by the yard and is the finest work in the Vale.
translated: She asks a question at the head of the stair, and any answer at all is taken for yes; give none. Marriage-lace is bought by the yard and is the finest work in the Vale.

text: It wears the face the sleeper trusts, so set the watch in pairs and let no one keep it alone. The token taken from a sleeper is bought sealed and is never handled twice.
translated: It wears the face the sleeper trusts, so set the watch in pairs and let no one keep it alone. The token taken from a sleeper is bought sealed and is never handled twice.

text: Common steel does nothing at all to it; bring a blessed edge up the crag or leave it in its chair. The backward palm is bought at the library's own price, and the library asks no questions.
translated: Common steel does nothing at all to it; bring a blessed edge up the crag or leave it in its chair. The backward palm is bought at the library's own price, and the library asks no questions.

text: It holds the stair and will not leave it, so fight it where it stands and never let it draw you up. Sealed grave-earth is bought by the handful and is kept sealed until the Guild opens it.
translated: It holds the stair and will not leave it, so fight it where it stands and never let it draw you up. Sealed grave-earth is bought by the handful and is kept sealed until the 行会 opens it.

translated: A dirty grey flag hangs above the stair: the warren has sent its heralds even here.

translated: The procession halts while you pass, by some instruction of precedence, and the empty helms turn to mark you.
