translated: The windlass turns at the rim far above, and the 行会 sends down the next name upon the roll, and you examine it at the door and send it home.

text: A claimant reaches the sill in the dark, finds the door kept and the count entered against it, and goes back down the way it came.
translated: A claimant reaches the sill in the dark, finds the door kept and the count entered against it, and goes back down the way it came.

text: The water stands where it lay, driven back and held, and the drum keeps its count in sevens under the works, and you keep the works.
translated: The water stands where it lay, driven back and 持有, and the drum keeps its count in sevens under the works, and you keep the works.

text: The first hoard lies warm and quiet at the bottom, the debt bound anew beneath it, and the glow of it dims and steadies as the breathing slows.
translated: The first hoard lies warm and quiet at the bottom, the debt bound anew beneath it, and the glow of it dims and steadies as the breathing slows.

text: You walk the offices of the keeping on your rounds, the Roll and the gallery and the debtors' deep, and you find the wardens' work sound and add your own to it.
translated: You walk the offices of the keeping on your rounds, the Roll and the gallery and the debtors' deep, and you find the wardens' work sound and add your own to it.

text: The chair at the last door is worn to its sitter through an age of sitting, and it is yours now, and the count is yours, and the season turns.
translated: The chair at the last door is worn to its sitter through an age of sitting, and it is yours now, and the count is yours, and the season turns.

text: Up the last stair on the circuit of the seven, mending what has worked loose since the last sitting
translated: Up the last stair on the circuit of the seven, mending what has worked loose since the last sitting

text: You make the circuit of the seven this season, from the sealed door above the crypts to the vault below the court, mending what has worked loose since the last sitting.
translated: You make the circuit of the seven this season, from the sealed door above the crypts to the vault below the court, mending what has worked loose since the last sitting.

text: A seal has slipped a hair at the elder stair, where the wyrm's weight is off it, and you set it true and enter the mending in the Roll.
translated: A seal has slipped a hair at the elder stair, where the wyrm's weight is off it, and you set it true and enter the mending in the Roll.

text: The lead of the struck seals is renewed where the damp has crept, six of them, and the seventh left whole, as the last warden kept it.
translated: The lead of the struck seals is renewed where the damp has crept, six of them, and the seventh left whole, as the last warden kept it.

text: The great chain lies bound again across the chained dark, its parted links drawn to and pinned, and the anchors hold, and you sign the mending beneath the seven hands.
translated: The great chain lies bound again across the chained dark, its parted links drawn to and pinned, and the anchors hold, and you sign the mending beneath the seven hands.

text: The works have gone a hair out of true with the season's water, and you weigh the counterweight afresh, and the drum takes up its count in sevens again.
translated: The works have gone a hair out of true with the season's water, and you weigh the counterweight afresh, and the drum takes up its count in sevens again.

text: The gallery of the seven keeps its six tenants and its nameless eighth, and you dust the effigies on your round and leave the chalk where it lies.
translated: The gallery of the seven keeps its six tenants and its nameless eighth, and you dust the effigies on your round and leave the chalk where it lies.

text: A weakness shows in the foundation where the drowned stone was worked from below, and you shore it and enter the figure, and the deep holds.
translated: A weakness shows in the foundation where the drowned 石 was worked from below, and you shore it and enter the figure, and the deep holds.

text: The manifest of the sealed is brought current in your own hand, every warden entered and every warden struck, and a place ruled clean for the name that keeps the count next.
translated: The manifest of the sealed is brought current in your own hand, every warden entered and every warden struck, and a place ruled clean for the name that keeps the count next.

text: The audit closes sound, the seven mended and the count kept, and you climb back to the chair at the last door with the season entered fair.
translated: The audit closes sound, the seven mended and the count kept, and you climb back to the chair at the last door with the season entered fair.

text: Up the last stair to read the Guild's letters, and to examine the next enrolment and send it home
translated: Up the last stair to read the 行会's letters, and to examine the next enrolment and send it home

text: The Guild writes to its warden this season, and sends down the next enrolment of adventurers with their numbered tags, to be examined at the door and sent home.
translated: The 行会 writes to its warden this season, and sends down the next enrolment of adventurers with their numbered tags, to be examined at the door and sent home.

text: A letter comes down the stair in a runner's hand, the Guild's own seal upon it, asking after the count and the seals and the health of the deep, and you answer it fair.
translated: A letter comes down the stair in a runner's hand, the 行会's own seal upon it, asking after the count and the seals and the health of the deep, and you answer it fair.

text: The next names upon the roll arrive at the last door, blinking in your lamp, and you rule them not yet ready and send them up with a word for the Guildmaster.
translated: The next names upon the roll arrive at the last door, blinking in your lamp, and you rule them not yet ready and send them up with a word for the Guildmaster.

text: The windlass turns above for each name sent home, and the Guild enters the examining, and the deep keeps one fewer numbered tag to fill.
translated: The windlass turns above for each name sent home, and the 行会 enters the examining, and the deep keeps one fewer numbered tag to fill.

text: You keep a fair copy of every letter from above in the new Roll, that the warden after you may read what passed between the deep and the surface in your season.
translated: You keep a fair copy of every letter from above in the new Roll, that the warden after you may read what passed between the deep and the surface in your season.

text: A tag comes down the stair with no adventurer behind it, recovered from some floor and sent to its warden, and you enter it and set it by.
translated: A tag comes down the stair with no adventurer behind it, recovered from some 楼层 and sent to its warden, and you enter it and set it by.

text: The jar keeps its place on the mantel through the reading and the writing both, the fire laid and unlit, and the count holds.
translated: The jar keeps its place on the mantel through the reading and the writing both, the fire laid and unlit, and the count holds.

text: The Guild's letters grow easy in their tone as the season turns, for the deep is quiet under a keeper who keeps it, and they say so, and you enter that too.
translated: The 行会's letters grow easy in their tone as the season turns, for the deep is quiet under a keeper who keeps it, and they say so, and you enter that too.

text: The last letter of the season goes up the windlass in your own hand, the count reported sound, and you take the chair at the door again and wait upon the next.
translated: The last letter of the season goes up the windlass in your own hand, the count reported sound, and you take the chair at the door again and wait upon the next.

text: Up the last stair to keep the count at the door, for the debt beneath turns in its new bonds
translated: Up the last stair to keep the count at the door, for the debt beneath turns in its new bonds

text: The debt beneath turns in its new bonds this season, and the drum wants re-weighting, and you set the counterweight true and keep the count at the door.
translated: The debt beneath turns in its new bonds this season, and the drum wants re-weighting, and you set the counterweight true and keep the count at the door.

text: The glow at the bottom brightens a shade as the debt stirs in its sleep, and dims again as the bonds hold, and you enter the stirring in the Roll.
translated: The glow at the bottom brightens a shade as the debt stirs in its sleep, and dims again as the bonds hold, and you enter the stirring in the Roll.

text: A tremor comes up the stair from the Bottom, felt through the chair and the floor, and it is the debt turning, and the bonds hold, and the count is kept.
translated: A tremor comes up the stair from the Bottom, felt through the chair and the 楼层, and it is the debt turning, and the bonds hold, and the count is kept.

text: The water tries the seal where the debt breathes hardest against it, and the works drive it back, and the drum keeps its sevens, and the works hold against the breathing.
translated: The water tries the seal where the debt breathes hardest against it, and the works drive it back, and the drum keeps its sevens, and the works hold against the breathing.

text: The first hoard lies warm at the bottom, the debt bound beneath it, and the coin shifts and rings as the great thing turns, and settles as it sleeps.
translated: The first hoard lies warm at the bottom, the debt bound beneath it, and the coin shifts and rings as the great thing turns, and settles as it sleeps.

text: You go down on your rounds to the waking ground and read the count in the bedrock, seven and seven, and the bright new mark is your own, cut this season.
translated: You go down on your rounds to the waking ground and read the count in the bedrock, seven and seven, and the bright new mark is your own, cut this season.

text: The debt sends the count up the stair to be told, as it has told every warden down, and you tell it back, and it settles, for a keeper answers where a corpse cannot.
translated: The debt sends the count up the stair to be told, as it has told every warden down, and you tell it back, and it settles, for a keeper answers where a corpse cannot.

text: The bonds you set upon the debt hold through the turning, closed link to link as the wardens closed them, and you sign the holding beneath the seven hands.
translated: The bonds you set upon the debt hold through the turning, closed link to link as the wardens closed them, and you sign the holding beneath the seven hands.

text: The count at the door is kept another season, the debt bound and the deep held, and you climb to the chair with the season entered and the jar upon its mantel above.
translated: The count at the door is kept another season, the debt bound and the deep 持有, and you climb to the chair with the season entered and the jar upon its mantel above.

text: The Emptied Deep
translated: The Emptied Deep

text: the Last Echo
translated: the Last Echo

text: the remnant the settling left behind, that walks among the salvage-gangs and the recovery-lamps and troubles no one that keeps to the light
translated: the remnant the settling left behind, that walks among the salvage-gangs and the recovery-lamps and troubles no one that keeps to the light

text: Down through the dead floors to the seat that no one keeps
translated: Down through the dead floors to the seat that no one keeps

text: among the salvage
translated: among the salvage

text: at the last recovery
translated: at the last recovery

text: The Last Echo thins to a draught and a cold and is gone, remnant and echo of a deep that is spent, and the season closes with one more floor charted and quiet.
translated: The Last Echo thins to a draught and a cold and is gone, remnant and echo of a deep that is spent, and the season closes with one more 楼层 charted and quiet.

text: The season concluded; the deep charted
translated: The season concluded; the deep charted

text: The season concludes, another floor of the dead deep charted and entered, and the clerk enters the season upon your count at the posted rate. The drum is silent, and the water stands where it lay.
translated: The season concludes, another 楼层 of the dead deep charted and entered, and the clerk enters the season upon your count at the posted rate. The drum is silent, and the water stands where it lay.

text: Down through the dead floors, where the Guild charts at leisure and the chains are measured for salvage
translated: Down through the dead floors, where the 行会 charts at leisure and the chains are measured for salvage

text: The Guild charts the dead floors at leisure this season, floor by floor, and the chains are measured for salvage, and what walks among the surveyors is remnant and echo.
translated: The 行会 charts the dead floors at leisure this season, 楼层 by 楼层, and the chains are measured for salvage, and what walks among the surveyors is remnant and echo.

text: The glow is gone from the Bottom, and the coin lies cold, and the surveyors chart it by lamplight, and it is only a hoard now, and they weigh it as one.
translated: The glow is gone from the Bottom, and the coin lies cold, and the surveyors chart it by lamplight, and it is only a hoard now, and they weigh it as one.

text: The drum is silent under the works, and the water stands where it lay, and the surveyors sound the still galleries and enter them stone by stone.
translated: The drum is silent under the works, and the water stands where it lay, and the surveyors sound the still galleries and enter them 石 by 石.

text: The great chain is measured for salvage along its slack miles, the parted links tallied, and the seven signatures at the anchors copied for the library before the iron is drawn up.
translated: The great chain is measured for salvage along its slack miles, the parted links tallied, and the seven signatures at the anchors copied for the library before the iron is drawn up.

text: A remnant crosses the survey's line in the dark, thin and aimless, and is turned aside with a lamp and a word, and it drifts back the way it came.
translated: A remnant crosses the survey's line in the dark, thin and aimless, and is turned aside with a lamp and a word, and it drifts back the way it came.

text: The seals are charted where they were struck, all seven, and the survey enters them a matter closed, and the wardens a line of keepers ended.
translated: The seals are charted where they were struck, all seven, and the survey enters them a matter closed, and the wardens a line of keepers ended.

text: The tally-marks in the bedrock are copied and left, seven and seven, the record of a count that is told, and the bright last mark is yours, and it is the last.
translated: The tally-marks in the bedrock are copied and left, seven and seven, the record of a count that is told, and the bright last mark is yours, and it is the last.

text: The dead floors keep no threat a lamp and a charter cannot pass, and the survey goes where no warden could send an adventurer living, and enters it all.
translated: The dead floors keep no threat a lamp and a charter cannot pass, and the survey goes where no warden could send an adventurer living, and enters it all.

text: The resurvey closes another floor charted and quiet, and the survey's lamps go up the stair, the season entered upon the record behind them.
translated: The resurvey closes another 楼层 charted and quiet, and the survey's lamps go up the stair, the season entered upon the record behind them.

text: Down through the deep the contractors strip by charter, where what walks among them is remnant and echo
translated: Down through the deep the contractors strip by charter, where what walks among them is remnant and echo

text: The Last Echo keeps to the salvage-gangs this season, remnant and echo among the contractors, and it comes upon you where the stripping is heaviest, because a thing of the deep goes where the deep is disturbed.
translated: The Last Echo keeps to the salvage-gangs this season, remnant and echo among the contractors, and it comes upon you where the stripping is heaviest, because a thing of the deep goes where the deep is disturbed.

text: Contractors strip the deep by charter this season, floor by floor, and what walks among the salvage-gangs is remnant and echo, and troubles no one that keeps to the lamp.
translated: Contractors strip the deep by charter this season, 楼层 by 楼层, and what walks among the salvage-gangs is remnant and echo, and troubles no one that keeps to the lamp.

text: The great chain comes up the stair link by link on the crane, sold for its iron, and the anchors are struck out and the seven signatures kept in the library.
translated: The great chain comes up the stair link by link on the crane, sold for its iron, and the anchors are struck out and the seven signatures kept in the library.

text: The works are drawn for their metal, the beam and the pumps and the counterweight, and the drum that kept the count is broken up and weighed as scrap of a good grade.
translated: The works are drawn for their metal, the beam and the pumps and the counterweight, and the drum that kept the count is broken up and weighed as scrap of a good grade.

text: The gallery of the seven is emptied by charter, the effigies crated for the survey and the tombs charted, and the nameless eighth left cut and empty, for no one comes to fill it now.
translated: The gallery of the seven is emptied by charter, the effigies crated for the survey and the tombs charted, and the nameless eighth left cut and empty, for no one comes to fill it now.

text: A salvage-gang leaves a floor stripped to the stone, and a remnant lingers a while where the deep was busiest, and thins, and is gone, and the floor stands empty as any worked-out level of the mines.
translated: A salvage-gang leaves a 楼层 stripped to the 石, and a remnant lingers a while where the deep was busiest, and thins, and is gone, and the 楼层 stands empty as any worked-out level of the mines.

text: The Roll Below is carried up volume by volume, the manifest of the sealed made a matter of the library, the lead bindings weighed and kept for the reading of the marks.
translated: 下方名册 is carried up volume by volume, the manifest of the sealed made a matter of the library, the lead bindings weighed and kept for the reading of the marks.

text: The coin of the first hoard is drawn up the windlass in barrels, cold now and only coin, struck by kings the survey enters as unknown, and the Bottom is left bare stone.
translated: The coin of the first hoard is drawn up the windlass in barrels, cold now and only coin, struck by kings the survey enters as unknown, and the Bottom is left bare 石.

text: The salvage runs by charter and by daylight terms, and the deep suffers it, for the deep is spent, and holds nothing now that a contractor need fear but the dark.
translated: The salvage runs by charter and by daylight terms, and the deep suffers it, for the deep is spent, and holds nothing now that a contractor need fear but the dark.

text: The salvage terms close another floor stripped and entered, and you climb back to the chair that keeps the tail, the season told and the echo grown fainter.
translated: The salvage terms close another 楼层 stripped and entered, and you climb back to the chair that keeps the tail, the season told and the echo grown fainter.

text: Down through the deep on the last recoveries, where the numbered tags of every lost party are brought up
translated: Down through the deep on the last recoveries, where the numbered tags of every lost party are brought up

text: The numbered tags of every party that went down are brought up this season, entered, and ruled recovered, one by one, and the Guild's long ledger of the missing is closed line by line.
translated: The numbered tags of every party that went down are brought up this season, entered, and ruled recovered, one by one, and the 行会's long ledger of the missing is closed line by line.

text: A tag comes up from a floor the survey has charted, the tag of a party lost an age ago, entered and sent to families the surface has forgotten, and ruled recovered.
translated: A tag comes up from a 楼层 the survey has charted, the tag of a party lost an age ago, entered and sent to families the surface has forgotten, and ruled recovered.

text: The dead of the deep are gathered where they lie and brought up under numbered litters, and the Roll of the missing is struck through name by name as they come.
translated: The dead of the deep are gathered where they lie and brought up under numbered litters, and the Roll of the missing is struck through name by name as they come.

text: A recovery party works the drowned foundation by lamplight, and brings up the tags of surveyors lost below where the stone was worked from both ends, and enters them recovered.
translated: A recovery party works the drowned foundation by lamplight, and brings up the tags of surveyors lost below where the 石 was worked from both ends, and enters them recovered.

text: What walks among the recovery-gangs is echo and remnant, and now and then it wears the tag of one being carried up, and lets it be taken, for the deep keeps nothing now.
translated: What walks among the recovery-gangs is echo and remnant, and now and then it wears the tag of one being carried up, and lets it be taken, for the deep keeps nothing now.

text: The tags of the Tuesday Party come up at last from a floor no warden would have sent them to, and are ruled recovered, and the ledger line is drawn in black.
translated: The tags of the Tuesday Party come up at last from a 楼层 no warden would have sent them to, and are ruled recovered, and the ledger line is drawn in black.

text: The Guild strikes the Maw from its charter as the last recoveries come up, and the recovered are entered against the count of the missing until the count is nothing.
translated: The 行会 strikes the Maw from its charter as the last recoveries come up, and the recovered are entered against the count of the missing until the count is nothing.

text: A face the deep remembers shows among the recovery-lamps and is gone, and the gang enters one more tag, the charter being silent upon echoes.
translated: A face the deep remembers shows among the recovery-lamps and is gone, and the gang enters one more tag, the charter being silent upon echoes.

text: The last recoveries bring one more party home this season, entered and ruled recovered, and the ledger of the missing stands the shorter for it.
translated: The last recoveries bring one more party home this season, entered and ruled recovered, and the ledger of the missing stands the shorter for it.

text: Down through the deep whose Roll is carried up volume by volume, where the librarians find their own survey in its pages
translated: Down through the deep whose Roll is carried up volume by volume, where the librarians find their own survey in its pages

text: The Roll Below is carried up volume by volume to the Guild library this season, and the librarians read the manifest of the sealed, and find their own survey entered in its last pages.
translated: 下方名册 is carried up volume by volume to the 行会 library this season, and the librarians read the manifest of the sealed, and find their own survey entered in its last pages.

text: A librarian reads a volume of the Roll and finds the survey's own party named in it, outward bound and struck through, in a hand set down before any of them was born, and enters the wonder in the margin.
translated: A librarian reads a volume of the Roll and finds the survey's own party named in it, outward bound and struck through, in a hand set down before any of them was born, and enters the wonder in the margin.

text: The lead bindings of the Roll are weighed and shelved, and the elder script of the eldest volumes is set to the copyists, and read at last, and it names the wardens down to the first.
translated: The lead bindings of the Roll are weighed and shelved, and the elder script of the eldest volumes is set to the copyists, and read at last, and it names the wardens down to the first.

text: What haunts the library is a draught and a cold, thin as a ruled margin, and it turns a page now and then in the reading-room, and the librarians keep a lamp burning for it at the reading-desk through the night.
translated: What haunts the library is a draught and a cold, thin as a ruled margin, and it turns a page now and then in the reading-room, and the librarians keep a lamp burning for it at the reading-desk through the night.

text: The count kept in the Roll is carried up entire, seven wardens and every debt, and the library files it under a heading the charter opened at the Bottom and closed there.
translated: The count kept in the Roll is carried up entire, seven wardens and every debt, and the library files it under a heading the charter opened at the Bottom and closed there.

text: A last volume comes up part-bound, its lead covers cut and its pages blank, the new Roll a keeper began and did not fill, and the library shelves it open at the first page.
translated: A last volume comes up part-bound, its lead covers cut and its pages blank, the new Roll a keeper began and did not fill, and the library shelves it open at the first page.

text: The librarians survey the whole descent from the pages alone now, floor by floor, and chart the Maw as a thing read rather than a thing entered, and find the account complete to the Bottom.
translated: The librarians survey the whole descent from the pages alone now, 楼层 by 楼层, and chart the Maw as a thing read rather than a thing entered, and find the account complete to the Bottom.

text: The quiet of the library is the quiet of the deep carried up, and the echo comes with the volumes and thins among the shelves, and the reading-lamps burn steady where no draught should reach them.
translated: The quiet of the library is the quiet of the deep carried up, and the echo comes with the volumes and thins among the shelves, and the reading-lamps burn steady where no draught should reach them.

text: The quiet ledger closes another volume shelved and read, and you climb to the chair that keeps the tail, the season entered and the Roll of the Maw standing complete upon the library shelf.
translated: The quiet ledger closes another volume shelved and read, and you climb to the chair that keeps the tail, the season entered and the Roll of the Maw standing complete upon the library shelf.

translated: Part-melted, and the last legible errand is a name and a 楼层. The name is entered elsewhere in this catalogue, and the 楼层 is closed.

text: Warm at recovery and paid double, per the posted rate. It has shown nothing since, and the night-porter stores it facing the wall regardless.
translated: Warm at recovery and paid double, per the posted rate. It has shown nothing since, and the night-porter stores it facing the wall regardless.

text: A specimen of the cockatrice yard. The assay rules it granite through, save for the heart, upon which the assay declines to rule.
translated: A specimen of the cockatrice yard. The assay rules it granite through, save for the heart, upon which the assay declines to rule.

text: Minted below to the true town's pattern, blank on both faces. The counter will neither take it nor give it back, and it is entered as a specimen accordingly.
translated: Minted below to the true town's pattern, blank on both faces. The 商店 will neither take it nor give it back, and it is entered as a specimen accordingly.

text: The ribbon that ruled his page. The library measured it three times and got three lengths, and files the mean, under the measurer's written protest.
translated: The ribbon that ruled his page. The library measured it three times and got three lengths, and files the mean, under the measurer's written protest.

text: Orders for castings run back an age, each marked settled in strong chalk. The last order stands open, and the works that would have filled it stand cold.
translated: Orders for castings run back an age, each marked settled in strong chalk. The last order stands open, and the works that would have filled it stand cold.

text: One tooth of the great brass rings, struck off in the fight and kept as proof of turning. It is warm at the hour, every hour, and the hour it keeps runs seven minutes fast.
translated: One tooth of the great brass rings, struck off in the fight and kept as proof of turning. It is warm at the hour, every hour, and the hour it keeps runs seven minutes fast.

text: Ground crystal in a brass frame, found folded upon the eyepiece. The library entered them as plain glass, then amended the entry, then locked the drawer.
translated: Ground crystal in a brass frame, found folded upon the eyepiece. The library entered them as plain glass, then amended the entry, then locked the drawer.

text: A gallery glass in miniature, showing its holder a half-second late. Certified harmless at the assay counter, twice, the second time at the assayer's own insistence.
translated: A gallery glass in miniature, showing its holder a half-second late. Certified harmless at the assay 商店, twice, the second time at the assayer's own insistence.

text: Guild tags of party No. 41, recovered
translated: 行会 tags of party No. 41, recovered

text: The tags of the Tuesday Party, drawn from the warren wall and sent home to the families. The bounty was paid in full, and the ledger line is ruled in black.
translated: The tags of the Tuesday Party, drawn from the warren wall and sent home to the families. The bounty was paid in full, and the ledger line is ruled in black.

text: a fist of raw silver ore
translated: a fist of raw silver ore

text: Proof of standing silver in a sealed mine. The assay counter paid the posted rate, and the survey office reopened a file it had marked closed.
translated: Proof of standing silver in a sealed mine. The assay 商店 paid the posted rate, and the survey office reopened a file it had marked closed.

text: the Tuesday Party's sealed provisions
translated: the Tuesday Party's sealed provisions

text: Guild issue, returned with every seal unbroken. Redeemed at the counter, and the families settled; the bread was three years old and sound.
translated: 行会 issue, returned with every seal unbroken. Redeemed at the 商店, and the families settled; the bread was three years old and sound.

text: Drawn in due form by a court that keeps its own law beneath the vault, and never served, the named party being the bearer. The library files it unserved, and renews the filing each season.
translated: Drawn in due form by a court that keeps its own law beneath the vault, and never served, the named party being the bearer. The library files it unserved, and renews the filing each season.

text: The order of business for one season of the lightless court, entered in a fair hand and complete to the last item. The final item is left blank, and the clerks decline to fill it.
translated: The order of business for one season of the lightless court, entered in a fair hand and complete to the last item. The final item is left blank, and the clerks decline to fill it.

text: A reckoning-stick of the eldest creditor, notched down its whole length and past all counting. The counting-house matched it against its own books, found the debt outstanding, and closed the ledger for the night.
translated: A reckoning-stick of the eldest creditor, notched down its whole length and past all counting. The counting-house matched it against its own books, found the debt outstanding, and closed the ledger for the night.

text: Gold, plain, and set with a grey stone that keeps no shine. The band is engraved within to a name the rolls do not carry, and the Guild keeps the ring against the day the name is entered.
translated: Gold, plain, and set with a grey 石 that keeps no shine. The band is engraved within to a name the rolls do not carry, and the 行会 keeps the 戒指 against the day the name is entered.

text: One coin, of the old dead king's mint and warm at recovery like the rest of that hoard. The custom it comes from lies outside the counter's charter, and the coin is entered as a specimen and let lie.
translated: One coin, of the old dead king's mint and warm at recovery like the rest of that hoard. The custom it comes from lies outside the 商店's charter, and the coin is entered as a specimen and let lie.

text: A single leaf from the roll the court keeps of its own dead, torn at the binding. The names upon it are entered in the order they will die, and the ink of the last is not yet dry.
translated: A single leaf from the roll the court keeps of its own dead, torn at the binding. The names upon it are entered in the order they will die, and the ink of the last is not yet dry.

text: The key opens every vault-door in the crypts, and one door besides that the survey has yet to find. It hangs with the other keys upon the ring, and the counter keeps it against the finding of that door.
translated: The key opens every vault-door in the crypts, and one door besides that the survey has yet to find. It hangs with the other keys upon the 戒指, and the 商店 keeps it against the finding of that door.

text: Drawn from a tomb-lamp still burning after an age underground. Decanted, sealed and shelved; the sample burns yet in its phial, and the library keeps a wet cloth beside it as a rule.
translated: Drawn from a tomb-lamp still burning after an age underground. Decanted, sealed and shelved; the sample burns yet in its phial, and the library keeps a wet cloth beside it as a rule.

text: A surveyor's lodestone, lost on some earlier descent and recovered far below where it was dropped. It points down, and holds to it however the case is turned.
translated: A surveyor's lodestone, lost on some earlier descent and recovered far below where it was dropped. It points down, and holds to it however the case is turned.

text: Struck from the tongue of a bell drowned before Mereward was named. It rings true when tapped, though no bell in the Guildhouse answers, and the counter keeps it wrapped in felt.
translated: Struck from the tongue of a bell drowned before Mereward was named. It rings true when tapped, though no bell in the 行会大厅 answers, and the 商店 keeps it wrapped in felt.

text: The burnt end of a wick from the court's funeral lamps, recovered cold. Set to a flame at the counter, it took the light at once and gave off no smoke, and was put out again by agreement.
translated: The burnt end of a wick from the court's funeral lamps, recovered cold. Set to a flame at the 商店, it took the light at once and gave off no smoke, and was put out again by agreement.

text: The porter's own list of the treasures kept facing the wall, in the porter's own hand. It names one shelf the catalogue does not, and the porter has asked that the list be kept facing the wall with the rest.
translated: The porter's own list of the treasures kept facing the wall, in the porter's own hand. It names one shelf the catalogue does not, and the porter has asked that the list be kept facing the wall with the rest.

text: Drawn and blessed at Saint Ordel before the abbey fell, and sealed with wax that carries the abbot's own thumb. The Guild keeps it sealed. There has been one application to open it, and it was refused in writing.
translated: Drawn and blessed at Saint Ordel before the abbey fell, and sealed with wax that carries the abbot's own thumb. The 行会 keeps it sealed. There has been one application to open it, and it was refused in writing.

text: Woven of one person's hair and set behind glass, with a date upon the back and no name. Eleven of these have come out of the Vale and every one of them carries the same date.
translated: Woven of one person's hair and set behind glass, with a date upon the back and no name. Eleven of these have come out of the Vale and every one of them carries the same date.

text: Cut, dried and bound in the manner the village keeps, and hung by the door rather than worn. The Guild's herbal rules it worthless against any beast in the book, and the Guild has bought every one offered.
translated: Cut, dried and bound in the manner the village keeps, and hung by the door rather than worn. The 行会's herbal rules it worthless against any 野兽 in the book, and the 行会 has bought every one offered.

text: The lamp is trimmed and filled, and the wick is white. The coach it belongs to stands in the stable-yard of the crag with its harness laid out and no horses in the Vale to put in it.
translated: The lamp is trimmed and filled, and the wick is white. The coach it belongs to stands in the stable-yard of the crag with its harness laid out and no horses in the Vale to put in it.

text: Plain silver, worn thin, and cut clean through as every ring out of that lake is cut. The inside carries a date, and the dates upon them run from three hundred years ago to the year before last.
translated: Plain silver, worn thin, and cut clean through as every 戒指 out of that lake is cut. The inside carries a date, and the dates upon them run from three hundred years ago to the year before last.

text: Cut from the Thornwake, seasoned two years and pointed by somebody who had done it before. The Guild lists it under implements rather than under arms, and lists no use beside it.
translated: Cut from the Thornwake, seasoned two years and pointed by somebody who had 完成 it before. The 行会 lists it under implements rather than under arms, and lists no use beside it.

text: A lady of the house in her wedding linen, painted from life by a good hand. The gallery upon the crag hangs the same face at full length, and in that canvas she is standing at the edge of the water.
translated: A lady of the house in her wedding linen, painted from life by a good hand. The gallery upon the crag hangs the same face at full length, and in that canvas she is standing at the edge of the water.

text: Dug out of the rubble of Saint Ordel's tower, cracked at the lip and sound elsewhere. It rings when the cold moves it, which the survey notes is not a thing bells do.
translated: Dug out of the rubble of Saint Ordel's tower, cracked at the lip and sound elsewhere. It rings when the cold moves it, which the survey notes is not a thing bells do.

text: Mounted in silver with the crow of Corvane cut into the boss. Blown correctly it calls the pack off; blown incorrectly it calls the pack in, and the Guild's note upon the label says which is which.
translated: Mounted in silver with the crow of Corvane cut into the 首领. Blown correctly it calls the pack off; blown incorrectly it calls the pack in, and the 行会's note upon the label says which is which.

text: Carry up
translated: Carry up

text: Carry down
translated: Carry down

text: Your torch burns lower, and the shadows press closer about you.
translated: Your torch burns lower, and the shadows press closer about you.

text: Far above, the creak of the Guild windlass echoes faintly down the shaft.
translated: Far above, the creak of the 行会 windlass echoes faintly down the shaft.

text: You take your rations by torchlight, watched from the dark by small unseen eyes.
translated: You take your rations by torchlight, watched from the dark by small unseen eyes.

text: The darkness of these depths is older by far than the Guild that charts them.
translated: The darkness of these depths is older by far than the 行会 that charts them.

text: You think of sunlight and the world above, now many fathoms overhead.
translated: You think of sunlight and the world above, now many fathoms overhead.

text: Somewhere far below, a great weight shifts, and dust sifts down from the roof of the passage.
translated: Somewhere far below, a great weight shifts, and dust sifts down from the roof of the passage.

text: Your lantern burns lower, and the mist comes in a hand's breadth closer about the light.
translated: Your lantern burns lower, and the mist comes in a hand's breadth closer about the light.

text: You take your rations sitting with your back to a wall, because in this valley everyone sits with their back to a wall.
translated: You take your rations sitting with your back to a wall, because in this valley everyone sits with their back to a wall.

text: The crag stands over you wherever you stand, and the house upon it keeps one window lit.
translated: The crag stands over you wherever you stand, and the house upon it keeps one window lit.

text: You count the days since the mist closed behind you upon the road, and the count is longer than your rations were meant to run.
translated: You count the days since the mist closed behind you upon the road, and the count is longer than your rations were meant to run.

text: Somewhere across the valley a horn is blown, one long note, and three quarters of the Vale answer it.
translated: Somewhere across the valley a horn is blown, one long note, and three quarters of the Vale answer it.

text: The light in this country never quite comes up and never quite goes, and the hour is whatever the lantern says it is.
translated: The light in this country never quite comes up and never quite goes, and the hour is whatever the lantern says it is.

text: A cold rain falls upon the rim, and the runoff sheets down the walls of the Maw in long grey ropes.
translated: A cold rain falls upon the rim, and the runoff sheets down the walls of the Maw in long grey ropes.

text: Water stands in every hollow of the old quarry, and your boots find each one.
translated: Water stands in every hollow of the old quarry, and your 靴子 find each one.

text: The rain drums upon your pack and runs cold beneath your collar as you work the upper stair.
translated: The rain drums upon your pack and runs cold beneath your collar as you work the upper stair.

text: A grey fog has come up out of the shaft, and the lantern shows you an arm's length of the road and no more.
translated: A grey fog has come up out of the shaft, and the lantern shows you an arm's length of the road and no more.

text: The fog lies thick upon the warren, and shapes move in it that resolve, as you near them, into stone.
translated: The fog lies thick upon the warren, and shapes move in it that resolve, as you near them, into 石.

text: Sound carries strangely in the murk: a drip close by, a voice far off, and no telling the distance of either.
translated: Sound carries strangely in the murk: a drip close by, a voice far off, and no telling the distance of either.

text: A hard frost has taken the rim, and the puddles of the quarry bear a skin of ice that cracks underfoot.
translated: A 严霜 has taken the rim, and the puddles of the quarry bear a skin of ice that cracks underfoot.

text: Your breath hangs white before you, and the iron of the windlass overhead is furred with rime.
translated: Your breath hangs white before you, and the iron of the windlass overhead is furred with rime.

text: The cold has driven the vermin deep, and the upper tunnels lie still and glittering.
translated: The cold has driven the vermin deep, and the upper tunnels lie still and glittering.

text: The air in the workings hangs dead and heavy, and your lantern-flame stands straight as a taper.
translated: The air in the workings hangs dead and heavy, and your lantern-flame stands straight as a taper.

text: No draught stirs the deep galleries, and the dust you raise settles slowly back into your own footprints.
translated: No draught stirs the deep galleries, and the dust you raise settles slowly back into your own footprints.

text: The stillness of the mines presses upon the ears, so that your own pulse sounds loud in the dark.
translated: The stillness of the mines presses upon the ears, so that your own pulse sounds loud in the dark.

text: A steady draught rises from the lower shafts, cold and constant, carrying the smell of wet stone.
translated: A steady draught rises from the lower shafts, cold and constant, carrying the smell of wet 石.

text: The cold wind out of the deep sets your torch streaming and gutters the lantern low.
translated: The cold wind out of the deep sets your torch streaming and gutters the lantern low.

text: Air moves up the cart-ways from somewhere far below, and it carries the chill of a place the sun has never found.
translated: Air moves up the cart-ways from somewhere far below, and it carries the chill of a place the sun has never found.

text: Water weeps from every seam of the rock, and the floor of the workings runs slick and black.
translated: Water weeps from every seam of the rock, and the 楼层 of the workings runs slick and black.

text: The damp has risen in the lower crypts, and the burial niches stand ankle-deep in still water.
translated: The damp has risen in the lower crypts, and the burial niches stand ankle-deep in still water.

text: Everything drips, and the water gathers in the sumps of the lower workings, black and slowly rising.
translated: Everything drips, and the water gathers in the sumps of the lower workings, black and slowly rising.

text: The black water is rising again, faster than the temple's drains can carry it, and it laps now at the second step of the nave.
translated: The black water is rising again, faster than the temple's drains can carry it, and it laps now at the second step of the nave.

text: The flood climbs the pillars of the undertemple, and the drowned saints upon them go under one by one.
translated: The flood climbs the pillars of the undertemple, and the drowned saints upon them go under one by one.

text: The water is at your waist and gaining, and somewhere below a sluice you cannot see labours and fails.
translated: The water is at your waist and gaining, and somewhere below a sluice you cannot see labours and fails.

text: The flood lies dead still, a black mirror from wall to wall, and your lantern hangs doubled beneath it.
translated: The flood lies dead still, a black mirror from wall to wall, and your lantern hangs doubled beneath it.

text: Not a ripple crosses the drowned nave, and the silence has the weight of deep water.
translated: Not a ripple crosses the drowned nave, and the silence has the weight of deep water.

text: The still water holds the cold of the deep, and the chill of it climbs your legs and settles in your knees.
translated: The still water holds the cold of the deep, and the chill of it climbs your legs and settles in your knees.

text: A slow cold current moves through the flooded temple, tugging at your legs and carrying strange flotsam past in the dark.
translated: A slow cold current moves through the flooded temple, tugging at your legs and carrying strange flotsam past in the dark.

text: The water is on the move, and it brings the reek of the lower drains up into the nave.
translated: The water is on the move, and it brings the reek of the lower drains up into the nave.

text: Something upstream has given way, and the current runs steady and cold along the sunken aisle.
translated: Something upstream has given way, and the current runs steady and cold along the sunken aisle.

text: The deep air lies utterly still, warm and close, and carries the mineral smell of stone that has never known the wind.
translated: The deep air lies utterly still, warm and close, and carries the mineral smell of 石 that has never known the wind.

text: No sound reaches you here but your own tread, loud in the close and airless dark.
translated: No sound reaches you here but your own tread, loud in the close and airless dark.

text: The calm of the deep is a pressure of its own, and the flame of your lantern never so much as leans.
translated: The calm of the deep is a pressure of its own, and the flame of your lantern never so much as leans.

text: A tremor runs through the deep stone, and dust sifts from the roof in thin grey veils.
translated: A tremor runs through the deep 石, and dust sifts from the roof in thin grey veils.

text: The rock shivers underfoot, once and then again, and small stones go rattling away down the dark.
translated: The rock shivers underfoot, once and then again, and small stones go rattling away down the dark.

text: Far below, the roots of the world shift their weight, and the tremor of it climbs the walls into your hands.
translated: Far below, the roots of the world shift their weight, and the tremor of it climbs the walls into your hands.

text: A cold current sighs through the halls, in and then out, slow as breathing, though no wind should reach this deep.
translated: A cold current sighs through the halls, in and then out, slow as breathing, though no wind should reach this deep.

text: Rime creeps along the gilt and the glass of the halls, and your breath freezes and falls as a fine glitter to the floor.
translated: Rime creeps along the gilt and the glass of the halls, and your breath freezes and falls as a fine glitter to the 楼层.

text: The lenses overhead cloud with frost, and the cold deepens by the hour, with no fire able to hold it back.
translated: The lenses overhead cloud with frost, and the cold deepens by the hour, with no fire able to hold it back.

text: The mist stands over the whole valley without moving, and it takes the far end of the road at fifty paces and gives nothing back.
translated: The mist stands over the whole valley without moving, and it takes the far end of the road at fifty paces and gives nothing back.

text: Sound carries oddly in the standing mist: a horn on the crag close at your shoulder, a voice in the next field a mile off.
translated: Sound carries oddly in the standing mist: a horn on the crag close at your shoulder, a voice in the next field a mile off.

text: The mist beads cold upon the lantern-horn and runs down it, and the light of it reaches an arm's length and stops.
translated: The mist beads cold upon the lantern-horn and runs down it, and the light of it reaches an arm's length and stops.

text: A fine cold rain comes down over the Vale, too light to drum and too steady to stop, and it has been falling since you came in.
translated: A fine cold rain comes down over the Vale, too light to drum and too steady to stop, and it has been falling since you came in.

text: The crag road runs with water, and the peat drinks it, and every hollow in the valley floor stands full and black.
translated: The crag road runs with water, and the peat drinks it, and every hollow in the valley 楼层 stands full and black.

text: The rain goes through wool in an hour and through leather in three, and the whole valley smells of wet thorn.
translated: The rain goes through wool in an hour and through leather in three, and the whole valley smells of wet thorn.

text: A killing frost is on the Vale, and the standing water bears weight, and the black thorn cracks where you brush it.
translated: A killing frost is on the Vale, and the standing water bears weight, and the black thorn cracks where you brush it.

text: Your breath hangs white before you and the mist has gone to ice in the air, and it glitters where the lantern reaches it.
translated: Your breath hangs white before you and the mist has gone to ice in the air, and it glitters where the lantern reaches it.

text: The frost drives everything living to ground and leaves the roads to whatever does not need to be warm.
translated: The frost drives everything living to ground and leaves the roads to whatever does not need to be warm.

text: the red moon
translated: the 红月

text: The moon comes up red through the shaft, and every dead thing this floor ever swallowed sits up to look at it.
translated: The moon comes up red through the shaft, and every dead thing this 楼层 ever swallowed sits up to look at it.

text: A red light stands in the deep that has no business being there, and the stone remembers what it is holding.
translated: A red light stands in the deep that has no business being there, and the 石 remembers what it is holding.

text: The red hour is on the floor, and what walks the galleries now was walking them long before you came down.
translated: The red hour is on the 楼层, and what walks the galleries now was walking them long before you came down.

text: The rain keeps the vermin to their holes: a quarter fewer ambushes while it falls.
translated: The rain keeps the vermin to their holes: a quarter fewer ambushes while it falls.

text: The murk stands against the watch: 2 off the eye that looks for traps and for ambushes.
translated: The murk stands against the watch: 2 off the eye that looks for traps and for ambushes.

text: -2 to spot traps and ambushes.
translated: -2 to spot traps and ambushes.

text: The cold drives the beasts deep: half as many ambushes while it holds.
translated: The cold drives the beasts deep: half as many ambushes while it holds.

text: Every sound carries in the dead air: 2 upon the watch against traps and ambushes.
translated: Every sound carries in the dead air: 2 upon the watch against traps and ambushes.

text: The draught worries the lantern: 1 off the watch against traps and ambushes.
translated: The draught worries the lantern: 1 off the watch against traps and ambushes.

text: -1 to spot traps and ambushes.
translated: -1 to spot traps and ambushes.

text: The water shuts the low ways, and the roads it forces are often the shorter: shortcuts come up half again as often.
translated: The water shuts the low ways, and the roads it forces are often the shorter: shortcuts come up half again as often.

text: Nothing moves and nothing sounds, so what does is heard at once: 2 upon the watch against traps and ambushes.
translated: Nothing moves and nothing sounds, so what does is heard at once: 2 upon the watch against traps and ambushes.

text: The current carries the deep's leavings past, and some are worth the taking: chests come up half again as often.
translated: The current carries the deep's leavings past, and some are worth the taking: chests come up half again as often.

text: The shaking springs the old works before you reach them: a third fewer traps left set.
translated: The shaking springs the old works before you reach them: a third fewer traps left set.

text: The frost takes the lantern-glass: 2 off the watch against traps and ambushes.
translated: The frost takes the lantern-glass: 2 off the watch against traps and ambushes.

text: The mist gives fifty paces and keeps the rest: half again as many ambushes.
translated: The mist gives fifty paces and keeps the rest: half again as many ambushes.

text: The frost puts everything living to ground: half as many ambushes while it holds.
translated: The frost puts everything living to ground: half as many ambushes while it holds.

text: mines:2
translated: mines:2

text: A seeping damp rises even here, and the sumps of the deep court fill and stand black and cold.
translated: A seeping damp rises even here, and the sumps of the deep court fill and stand black and cold.

text: The old wet of the workings finds the court at last, and the water gathers in the low seats of the seven.
translated: The old wet of the workings finds the court at last, and the water gathers in the low seats of the seven.

text: Water weeps from the court's own stone as it wept in the mines a hundred fathoms above, and the floor runs slick.
translated: Water weeps from the court's own 石 as it wept in the mines a hundred fathoms above, and the 楼层 runs slick.

text: The Ropewalk
translated: The Ropewalk

text: The supply-basket comes down on a strange rope, stiff and new and smelling of tar. The great rope is up and walked out for the Ropewalk, and this one carries you until it is spliced.
translated: The supply-basket comes down on a strange rope, stiff and new and smelling of tar. The great rope is up and walked out for the Ropewalk, and this one carries you until it is spliced.

text: The First Weighing
translated: The First Weighing

text: Word comes down the shaft with the basket: Master Pell has carried his scales into the square for the First Weighing, and the year-book is opened at a fresh page beside them.
translated: Word comes down the shaft with the basket: Master Pell has carried his scales into the square for the First Weighing, and the year-book is opened at a fresh page beside them.

text: The Assize of Lamps
translated: The Assize of Lamps

text: The oil in this week's basket is sealed and stamped twice over, and the winch-keeper's note gives the reason: the Assize of Lamps is held above, and every quart in the town goes to the Guildhouse step to be tried.
translated: The oil in this week's basket is sealed and stamped twice over, and the winch-keeper's note gives the reason: the Assize of Lamps is 持有 above, and every quart in the town goes to the 行会大厅 step to be tried.

text: The Beasts' Muster
translated: The Beasts' 集会

text: A party climbing past you has word of the Beasts' Muster: the green is full of the Guild's animals, and the farrier has been at work since dawn with two apprentices holding the heads.
translated: A party climbing past you has word of the Beasts' 集会: the green is full of the 行会's animals, and the farrier has been at work since dawn with two apprentices holding the heads.

text: The Issue of Tags
translated: The Issue of Tags

text: The Guild strikes the year's numbered tags for the recovery of remains and issues them at the counter across three days. A tag comes back with its bearer or it comes back alone, and the charter provides for both.
translated: The 行会 strikes the year's numbered tags for the recovery of remains and issues them at the 商店 across three days. A tag comes back with its bearer or it comes back alone, and the charter provides for both.

text: The Sounding of the Bell
translated: The Sounding of the Bell

text: The bellfounder comes up from the county to sound the Guild bell through and read its tone. The count of that sounding is entered in the year-book and chalked upon the Guildhouse door for the town to read.
translated: The bellfounder comes up from the county to sound the 行会 bell through and read its tone. The count of that sounding is entered in the year-book and chalked upon the 行会大厅 door for the town to read.

text: The Guild bell sounds through the rock above you, stroke upon stroke, slower than any alarm. The founder has it down from its frame for the Sounding, and every stroke is a party still out upon the Maw.
translated: The 行会 bell sounds through the rock above you, stroke upon stroke, slower than any alarm. The founder has it down from its frame for the Sounding, and every stroke is a party still out upon the Maw.

text: The Mason's Day
translated: The Mason's Day

text: The mason sets his trestle at the memorial wall and cuts the season's names into the roll of the returned. A clear span of stone is left below the last of them, as the charter requires.
translated: The mason sets his trestle at the memorial wall and cuts the season's names into the roll of the returned. A clear span of 石 is left below the last of them, as the charter requires.

text: Fresh stone dust lies across the basket lid, and a second line is chalked beside the depth. The mason is at the memorial wall today, and he works there until the light fails.
translated: Fresh 石 dust lies across the basket lid, and a second line is chalked beside the depth. The mason is at the memorial wall today, and he works there until the light fails.

text: The Signing
translated: The Signing

text: A runner sent down to the stair-head brings word that the Signing is on above. The board stands three deep in new hands, and the charter's terms have been read aloud since first light without a pause for dinner.
translated: A runner sent down to the stair-head brings word that the Signing is on above. The board stands three deep in new hands, and the charter's terms have been read aloud since first light without a pause for dinner.

text: The Reading of the Overdue
translated: The Reading of the Overdue

text: The Quarter's Ruling
translated: The Quarter's Ruling

text: Master Pell rules off the quarter in the year-book across three days, and every account in Mereward is brought to the counter to be agreed. The Guild's takings, its debts and its dead are entered under the same rule.
translated: Master Pell rules off the quarter in the year-book across three days, and every account in Mereward is brought to the 商店 to be agreed. The 行会's takings, its debts and its dead are entered under the same rule.

text: The counter sends its own notice down with the basket, in a fair round hand: the year-book is open for the Quarter's Ruling, and the queue for it runs out of the Guildhouse door and down the step.
translated: The 商店 sends its own notice down with the basket, in a fair round hand: the year-book is open for the Quarter's Ruling, and the queue for it runs out of the 行会大厅 door and down the step.

text: Old Hesper pays out another length of rope upon the windlass far above, and the creak of it follows you down the stair.
translated: Old Hesper pays out another length of rope upon the windlass far above, and the creak of it follows you down the stair.

text: The supply-basket comes down on Hesper's line with a candle, a heel of bread, and the new depth chalked upon the lid in the winch-keeper's hand.
translated: The supply-basket comes down on Hesper's line with a candle, a heel of bread, and the new depth chalked upon the lid in the winch-keeper's hand.

text: Word comes down the shaft in Old Hesper's voice, giving the depth and the weather, in that order, as he has given them for forty years.
translated: Word comes down the shaft in Old Hesper's voice, giving the depth and the 天气, in that order, as he has given them for forty years.

text: Far above, Old Hesper cuts a fresh notch in the windlass-post, one for every floor a member of the Guild has won.
translated: Far above, Old Hesper cuts a fresh notch in the windlass-post, one for every 楼层 a member of the 行会 has won.

text: A token clatters down the shaft and rings upon the stone: Old Hesper's mark, sent down to every member who wins a new floor.
translated: A token clatters down the shaft and rings upon the 石: Old Hesper's mark, sent down to every member who wins a new 楼层.

text: The windlass rope twitches twice, high above: Old Hesper's signal that the new depth is entered upon the board at the rim.
translated: The windlass rope twitches twice, high above: Old Hesper's signal that the new depth is entered upon the board at the rim.

text: Old Hesper hails you from the windlass: the rope ran steady the whole while, and the chronicle below kept itself.
translated: Old Hesper hails you from the windlass: the rope ran steady the whole while, and the chronicle below kept itself.

text: Old Hesper reads you the windlass-post, notch by notch, before you are fairly off the platform.
translated: Old Hesper reads you the windlass-post, notch by notch, before you are fairly off the platform.

text: Old Hesper reports the shaft in good order: the rope is sound, the baskets ran to time, and the deep behaved itself.
translated: Old Hesper reports the shaft in good order: the rope is sound, the baskets ran to time, and the deep behaved itself.

text: Old Hesper touches his cap from the windlass and allows that it was a quiet watch, as watches upon the Maw are reckoned.
translated: Old Hesper touches his cap from the windlass and allows that it was a quiet watch, as watches upon the Maw are reckoned.

text: Old Hesper turns out his tally of the watch: so many baskets down, so many up, and every member accounted for.
translated: Old Hesper turns out his tally of the watch: so many baskets down, so many up, and every member accounted for.

text: Master Pell enters the sum in the ledger and rules the line beneath it.
translated: Master Pell enters the sum in the ledger and rules the line beneath it.

text: "The Guild buys by weight," says Master Pell. "The Guild has always bought by weight."
translated: "The 行会 buys by weight," says Master Pell. "The 行会 has always bought by weight."

text: Master Pell weighs the lot twice, as the charter requires, and the second weighing agrees with the first.
translated: Master Pell weighs the lot twice, as the charter requires, and the second weighing agrees with the first.

text: "Sound goods," says Master Pell, and stamps the receipt in triplicate.
translated: "Sound goods," says Master Pell, and stamps the receipt in triplicate.

text: Master Pell reads the sum aloud before entering it, so the seller and the ledger hear it together.
translated: Master Pell reads the sum aloud before entering it, so the seller and the ledger hear it together.

text: "The counter has seen finer," says Master Pell, "and paid less for it."
translated: "The 商店 has seen finer," says Master Pell, "and paid less for it."

text: Master Pell dusts the page with sand and carries the figure to the year-book while you wait.
translated: Master Pell dusts the page with sand and carries the figure to the year-book while you wait.

text: "One part in ten to the recovery fund," says Master Pell, "per the terms of the charter."
translated: "One part in ten to the recovery fund," says Master Pell, "per the terms of the charter."

text: Master Pell holds each trophy to the lamp, names its beast to the shelf behind him, and pays the posted rate to the copper.
translated: Master Pell holds each 战利品 to the lamp, names its 野兽 to the shelf behind him, and pays the posted rate to the copper.

text: "The ledger closes at the bell and opens at the bell," says Master Pell. "Between the bells, it is open."
translated: "The ledger closes at the bell and opens at the bell," says Master Pell. "Between the bells, it is open."

text: Master Wickett cuts a notch of his own upon the counter of his shop, apart from the village tally, one for every quarter of the Vale you have carried.
translated: Master Wickett cuts a notch of his own upon the 商店 of his shop, apart from the village tally, one for every quarter of the Vale you have carried.

text: A candle burns in Master Wickett's window through the whole of the night now, set there for you, and the chandler can afford it better than most.
translated: A candle burns in Master Wickett's window through the whole of the night now, set there for you, and the chandler can afford it better than most.

text: Master Wickett has the map of the valley out upon his counter when you pass, and another quarter of it is inked in, and the inking is in your hand and his together.
translated: Master Wickett has the map of the valley out upon his 商店 when you pass, and another quarter of it is inked in, and the inking is in your hand and his together.

text: Word goes round Hollowmere before you are off the street: another part of the Vale has been walked and come back from, and the village hears it out from behind its shutters.
translated: Word goes round Hollowmere before you are off the street: another part of the Vale has been walked and come back from, and the village hears it out from behind its shutters.

text: Master Wickett sets a second chair beside his fire, which he has not done in eleven years, and lets it stand there and speaks of the weather instead.
translated: Master Wickett sets a second chair beside his fire, which he has not 完成 in eleven years, and lets it stand there and speaks of the 天气 instead.

text: The chandler's boy runs ahead of you down the row with the news, and one shutter in five comes off its bar to hear him out.
translated: The chandler's boy runs 前方 of you down the row with the news, and one shutter in five comes off its bar to hear him out.

text: Master Wickett reports the village quiet the whole while: the shutters barred at dusk, the notch cut, and the bread taken off the doorsteps by morning as ever.
translated: Master Wickett reports the village quiet the whole while: the shutters barred at dusk, the notch cut, and the bread taken off the doorsteps by morning as ever.

text: Master Wickett has kept his own tally against your return, and reads it off the counter, notch by notch, before you are fairly through the door.
translated: Master Wickett has kept his own tally against your return, and reads it off the 商店, notch by notch, before you are fairly through the door.

text: Master Wickett allows that it was an ordinary stretch of nights by the reckoning of this valley, and pours you something out of a bottle he keeps under the counter.
translated: Master Wickett allows that it was an ordinary stretch of nights by the reckoning of this valley, and pours you something out of a bottle he keeps under the 商店.

text: The chandler turns out his account of the absence: so many candles sold, so many doorsteps served, and every soul in Hollowmere still upon the roll.
translated: The chandler turns out his account of the absence: so many candles sold, so many doorsteps served, and every soul in Hollowmere still upon the roll.

text: Master Wickett touches his cap and says the Vale behaved itself, and then adds that the Vale always behaves itself, and that a valley which behaves itself has something keeping it in order.
translated: Master Wickett touches his cap and says the Vale behaved itself, and then adds that the Vale always behaves itself, and that a valley which behaves itself has something keeping it in order.

text: Master Wickett enters the sum in the ledger he keeps under the counter and rules the line beneath it.
translated: Master Wickett enters the sum in the ledger he keeps under the 商店 and rules the line beneath it.

text: "There is no carrier out of this valley," says Master Wickett, "so what I buy, I keep. Which suits me and suits you."
translated: "There is no carrier out of this valley," says Master Wickett, "so what I buy, I keep. Which suits me and suits you."

text: Master Wickett weighs the lot twice by candle-light, and the second weighing agrees with the first.
translated: Master Wickett weighs the lot twice by candle-light, and the second weighing agrees with the first.

text: "Sound goods," says Master Wickett, and pays you in the Count\
translated: "Sound goods," says Master Wickett, and pays you in the Count\
